sections.descriptionDraft: Northern start of the Stockholm Archipelago Trail, looping from Arholma quay through hamlets, gravel roads, forest paths and a more technical eastern coastal section with views over the Aland Sea. The route has good island services for a small archipelago section, but many are seasonal and water reliability should be checked before relying on it.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Reach Arholma year-round via bus/car to Simpnas and the short Waxholmsbolaget/Krokholmens passenger boat to Arholma. Summer options may include boats from Stockholm, Norrtalje/Norra batlinjen and the Nord/Syd line. Timetables change by season and some departures require request/prebooking, so check SL/Waxholmsbolaget before locking an itinerary.
sections.campingRulesDraft: Arholma-Ido is a nature reserve. Tenting in the same place for more than two consecutive days is prohibited except at established campsites. The official SAT page notes a campsite just north of the ferry quay. Fires are only allowed at designated fireplaces, never on rocks, and all fire bans override stored data.
utilitiesDraft: Arholma ferry quay has the key arrival cluster: Arholma Handel, Bryggcafet in season, nearby toilets and the start/end of the loop.
Arholma Handel is the main resupply point and is described as year-round, but low-season opening hours are limited.
Arholma Nord and Bull-August provide lodging and food/service options with seasonal or booking-dependent availability.
Dry toilets are reported at the campsite, Ahlmansviken/guest-harbor area, Osterhamn and Arholma Nord; winter availability is limited.
No overnight wind shelter was confirmed in the first research cycle.
waterSourcesDraft: Carry enough water for the full 13.4 km unless current potable water access has been confirmed.
Official SAT guidance says water is available at Österhamn guest harbor/pump but not in winter.

Osterhamn pump is the best confirmed drinking-water point in season: mapped around 59.845399, 19.121137, about 100 m from the guest harbor rather than on the pontoon, but official SAT says it is not available in winter.
Ahlmansviken/campsite pump needs caution: community/OSM/Wikimedia notes report uncertain potable status, high iron or untested/brown water.
No reliable public winter water source was confirmed; winter plans should rely on carried water, ferry toilets, purchases during shop hours, or customer/guest access at open businesses.
notesDraft: Trail is marked with blue/yellow/reflection SAT markings and official guidance recommends clockwise travel.
Eastern coastal part is more technical, with rock/root terrain; forest road can be wet in spring or after rain.
Recent community reports in 2025 mostly describe good conditions and easy navigation, with one muddy/obstruction report.
Dogs must be leashed in the nature reserve; this is stricter than the general SAT March-September guidance.
From April 1 to July 31, landing on Röd-/Nollekobben bird-protection islets or entering water within 100 m is prohibited; these are not on the main loop but are inside the same reserve.
Ticks/TBE are a general archipelago/Stockholm coastal concern from spring through autumn; late-July algal blooms can affect swimming.
Pack out trash; island waste handling is limited.

sections.descriptionDraft: Lidö is a compact island loop through meadows, storm-shaped reserve forest, rocky coastline and coastal history. The route starts at Lidö ferry quay by Lidö Värdshus, passes Ryssugnen, follows the northern shore, reaches the Österhamn area and Lidö Battery detour, then loops back through forest toward the inn. The current 2026 H25 route is about 11.2 km; food, water and guest-harbor services are strongly seasonal, while access from Räfsnäs is year-round and Stockholm/Vaxholm, Norra båtlinjen and Nord/Syd options are seasonal/date-specific.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Reach Lidö year-round from Räfsnäs brygga by Waxholmsbolaget ferry; the crossing is about 10 minutes. Public transport commonly uses bus 676 from Stockholm/Tekniska högskolan to Norrtälje and bus 631 or limited/seasonal 631X to Räfsnäs brygga. Some low-season Waxholmsbolaget departures require advance booking/request according to timetable notes. In summer, additional options may include Stockholm/Vaxholm boats, Norra båtlinjen July 6-August 9, 2026, and the SAT Nord/Syd line June 22-August 16, 2026; exact operator timetables should be checked for the hiking date.
sections.campingRulesDraft: Lidö is a nature reserve managed by Skärgårdsstiftelsen. Fires are only allowed at designated places, dogs must be leashed, and tenting in the same place is limited to no more than two nights. The main tenting area is at Österhamn, with dry toilet, waste hut and firepit but no confirmed drinking water. The northwest wind shelter appears public/visitor-accessible and has a fireplace, but should not be treated as bookable or guaranteed overnight accommodation. Current fire bans and posted signs override stored data.
utilitiesDraft: Lidö Värdshus is the main island service hub near the ferry quay, with lodging and restaurant service in season; 2026 restaurant service begins around midsummer and is most reliable in weeks 28-31.
Oasen at the guest harbor opens June 20, 2026 and is the key casual summer food/service point; hours are weather- and season-dependent.

Guest-harbor drinking water, toilets and showers exist near Båthusviken/Oasen, but access should be treated as seasonal and customer/harbor-user dependent; access for non-boating hikers is not explicitly stated, and showers should not be exposed as free public trail infrastructure.

Österhamn is Lidö's northeastern natural harbor and basic tenting area, with a simple tent site, dry toilet/sopmaja service, designated fire area, and natural bathing/rocks nearby, but no confirmed drinking-water source.

A northwest wind shelter with fireplace is shown by Naturkartan/OSM/Wikivoyage/Wikimedia. The current H25 GPX appears to pass essentially by it, while the Swedish step-by-step describes it as a short side path; it is likely public but not bookable.
No grocery shop was confirmed on Lidö; treat food as restaurant/cafe/meal service rather than resupply.
waterSourcesDraft: Carry enough water for the section unless current guest-harbor water access has been confirmed.

A mapped drinking-water point at Lidö guest harbor/Båthusviken is around 59.773148, 19.079310; local sources describe fresh water at a separate dock, but access for non-boating hikers is not explicitly stated and should be verified with Lidö Värdshus/Oasen.
No reliable drinking-water source was confirmed at Österhamn tent site after four iterations.
Outside the summer service period, assume limited or no water service unless confirmed directly with Lidö Värdshus or current official sources.
notesDraft: Official SAT says route marking is one-directional, with denser marking at unclear junctions and more sporadic marking where the way is obvious.
The route is recommended clockwise.
Lidö forest sections are visibly affected by Storm Alfrida and spruce bark beetle damage; expect uneven woodland paths, dead or fallen trees, and occasional obstacles.

A forestry-work caution was issued for September 5 to early October 2025 while heavy machinery cleared storm-felled trees. Treat this as historical unless re-confirmed; no current official closure or reroute notice was found on April 26, 2026.
September 2025 user reports still mentioned many trees/obstacles on the route, while July/August 2025 AllTrails reports described good conditions. Allow a little extra time in forest sections.
Do not show a generic mud warning prominently; no strong Lidö-specific 2024-2026 chronic mud problem was found.

Natural bathing/rocks exist around the island and near Österhamn, but the exact Österhamn swim coordinate is mostly map/community evidence; mention as informal nearby bathing rather than a main high-confidence facility.
Use the pier semaphore/signal board when required so Waxholmsbolaget boats stop.
For Waxholmsbolaget timetable notes, b/B departures require advance booking/request; semaphore use does not replace required prebooking.
Regional tick/TBE and late-summer algae risks apply, but no Lidö-specific tick or algae incident was found in iteration 1.
adminVerificationNotesDraft: Before showing an active Lidö condition warning, re-check SAT News and Lansstyrelsen Lidö. SAT said they would announce when the 2025 forestry work finished, but no specific completion post was found in iteration 3.
Do not expose exact 2026 restaurant/Oasen hours as permanent data unless the app supports dated seasonal schedules.
Confirm whether guest-harbor toilets/water are accessible to non-boaters outside Oasen opening hours before using stronger public-access wording.
Fire and grass-fire risk should be checked dynamically near release/travel date and not stored as static Lidö route data.

sections.name: Furusund
sections.routeShape: short Furusund loop / round trip that can start at the ferry terminal or Furusunds Värdshus, recommended clockwise, following local red markings rather than SAT signs

Komoot is about 6.95 km, AllTrails/HiiKER SAT variants are about 6.8 km, and a shorter AllTrails red loop around 5.8 km is not the full SAT-facing route.
sourceConflicts.preferredTreatment: Use 6.9 km / about 2 hours as the current route-geometry value, with an internal note that the public SAT page still says 7.2 km.

Community/map/review sources are useful for QA but should not be visible authority unless no better source exists.

sections.descriptionDraft: Furusund is a short coastal-history loop in the northern Stockholm archipelago, mixing village lanes, sea views, maritime history, literary associations and exterior cultural landmarks. The current official PDF/Outdooractive route geometry supports about 6.9 km / 2 hours even though the public SAT page still says 7.2 km. The route is not SAT-marked; much follows local red markings, and it is best walked clockwise with the SAT map or GPX available.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Furusund is reachable year-round by SL bus via Norrtälje, mainly using lines 632 and 634 to Furusunds hotellplan or Furusunds färjeläge, or by car. Waxholmsbolaget passenger boats call at Furusund/Furusund brygga on date-specific timetables; line 27 is shown for spring and autumn 2026, while summer/Nord-Syd departures should be checked in the Waxholmsbolaget planner. The free Trafikverket road ferry Furusund-Köpmanholm/Yxlan connects Furusund with the Yxlan side and takes about 4 minutes.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Furusunds färjeläge
accessMetadataDraft.description: Primary bus and road-ferry access node for the Furusund loop and the Yxlan connection. Keep as access metadata, not a facility, unless a current public WC/water source is separately verified.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Furusunds hotellplan
accessMetadataDraft.description: Central SL bus stop near Hotell Furusund/Furusunds Värdshus and local services. Treat as transport metadata only.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Furusund passenger pier / Tullbryggan
accessMetadataDraft.description: Waxholmsbolaget/archipelago-boat access point and possible section start. Passenger-boat service is seasonal/date-specific and should be checked for the hiking date.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Furusund-Köpmanholm/Yxlan road ferry
accessMetadataDraft.description: Free Trafikverket ferry across Furusundsleden, about 600 m / 4 minutes, linking Furusund with Köpmanholm/Yxlan for the next SAT section.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Furusund central parking
accessMetadataDraft.description: A few hotel spaces plus larger paid parking areas before the inn are described by Hotell Furusund, including overnight parking according to the page. Verify fees, signs and rules before relying on it. Keep as access metadata, not a trail facility.

sections.campingRulesDraft: No confirmed designated campsite, tent site, shelter or good wild-camping facility was found on Furusund. Furusund is small, residential and shoreline-sensitive, so do not encourage wild camping. If mentioned at all: no designated campsite found; use lodging or continue to another section. Any allemansrätten camping must be short, discreet, far from homes, and outside prohibited public/bathing/trail areas. Fires should only use fixed prepared places where permitted, never on bare rock, and current fire-ban status overrides stored route data.
utilitiesDraft: Food and service are concentrated around Hotell Furusund / Furusunds Värdshus and Furusunds Hamn / Hamnkrog.
Furusunds Gästhamn has guest-harbor water, WC, shower and waste services, but these should be treated as seasonal/harbor-service facilities rather than guaranteed free public hiker infrastructure.

No grocery/resupply shop was confirmed with high confidence; Skärgårdsmacken/Furusundsmacken is a weak local fuel/post/kiosk/service candidate and should not be exposed as dependable grocery resupply.
No official campsite was found; lodging options include Hotell Furusund/Furusunds Värdshus and Villa Dagmar.

Furusundsbadplats and Myrudden are supported as simple local bathing/firepit spots by community/map/photo evidence. Do not label them municipal, monitored or water-quality tested beaches, and do not assume maintenance, firewood, toilets or water.
waterSourcesDraft: Carry water unless guest-harbor water access has been verified for the date.
The best candidate refill is Furusunds Gästhamn, but it is harbor infrastructure and should be treated as seasonal/fee/service-dependent.
Hotell Furusund and Hamnkrogen may have customer toilets when open; do not treat them as public toilets.

Do not expose Duvkällan or road-ferry terminal facilities as water/toilet resources; iteration 2 found evidence the Duvkällan pump is broken/non-potable and no current reliable ferry-terminal toilet replacement.
notesDraft: The route is not SAT-marked; much of it follows local red markings, but users should keep the SAT map/GPX available, especially through village/residential sections and intersections.
Recent 2026 AllTrails reports were generally positive and no active Furusund-specific SAT closure/reroute notice was found on April 26, 2026.
Check SAT news/report pages before hiking, but do not show a stored Furusund closure unless a current official notice appears.
The loop is short and village/coastal in character, but SAT labels it Moderate and notes a short steeper/rooty section on the west coast north of the bridge; it is not fully pram/wheelchair-friendly.
Expect a more village/residential feel than remote trail; one 2025 user report described substantial residential/concrete/manufactured path.

In winter/early spring, expect possible slippery, muddy or icy patches and reduced services. Furusund remains year-round reachable by bus/car, but users should verify return buses and ferry/boat connections for the travel date.

For Yxlan continuation, the free Trafikverket road ferry Furusund-Yxlan is normally the key link. A June 2025 ferry-capacity disruption was found, but no current April 2026 Furusundsleden disruption surfaced; traffic should be checked dynamically.
The route passes historic/literary houses; keep wording respectful and do not encourage close approach to private residences.
Do not reuse old Furusund tourist-info notes about 2019-2020 brygga repairs as current closure information.
Nearby Länsstyrelsen Furusundsfjärden nature reserve is not the main walking loop; do not apply its reserve-specific rules to the SAT route unless the user detours there.

iterationSummaries.focus: Broad first-pass coverage: official/authority pages, facilities and coordinates, transport/services, community/current-condition evidence and app-shaped synthesis.
keyFindings: Furusund is a short coastal/cultural-history loop in Norrtälje municipality with village lanes, sea views and the carved compass rose as a major highlight.
SAT lists Moderate, 7.2 km and about 2 hours; the linked print PDF and Outdooractive route list 6.9 km / 2:00 h, so a GPX measurement is needed in iteration 2.
The section is not SAT-marked. It follows local red markings and the interactive map; multiple user reports mention incomplete or confusing marking in places.
Recommended direction is clockwise; start options are Furusund ferry terminal or Furusunds Värdshus.
No active Furusund-specific SAT closure/reroute notice was found on April 26, 2026. Recent March/April 2026 AllTrails condition reports were generally positive.
The route is mostly easy/flat but includes narrow rooty/rocky sections and is not fully pram/wheelchair-friendly.
Furusund has a more village/residential feel than remote trail; this matters for camping and user expectations.
Food/service anchors are Hotell Furusund/Furusunds Värdshus and Furusunds Hamn/Hamnkrog.
Furusunds Gästhamn provides water/WC/shower/waste services, but these are harbor/service-area facilities and should be caveated as seasonal/fee/service-dependent.
No official campsite or outdoor tent site was confirmed. Do not present Furusund as an easy wild-camping section.
Duvkällan should not be exposed as drinking water because the nearby pump/well appears broken/non-potable in map evidence.
Fireplace/bathing candidates exist at Furusundsbadplats and Myrudden, but the evidence is mostly community/photo/map based and needs further verification.
Transport is unusually strong: bus via Norrtälje, road access, free Trafikverket ferry to Köpmanholm/Yxlan, seasonal archipelago boats, and Nord/Syd dates listed by SAT for June 22-August 16, 2026.

keyFindings: Use 6.9 km and about 2 hours as the current route-geometry value. Official SAT page copy says 7.2 km, but official linked GPX/PDF/Outdooractive geometry measures about 6.84-6.88 km.

Furusundsbadplats and Myrudden can remain medium-confidence bathing/fireplace candidates, but they are not confirmed municipal monitored beaches or water-quality tested sites. Fire-ban/no-fire-on-rock caveats are required.

sections.descriptionDraft: A long, sparse north-to-south archipelago hike across Yxlan, starting at Köpmanholm and passing pine forest, meadows, narrow roads, cottage areas, historic villages, rocky shoreline, lake Träsket, Hamnviken, cultural traces near Kasberget and the Vadholmen/Yxlan lighthouse area. The current official PDF/Outdooractive route is about 22.4 km after the August 2025 route change. The trail is not physically SAT-marked; follow the local tourist map's green-dotted route or the official interactive map/GPX.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Yxlan is usually reached via Furusund and the free Trafikverket road ferry to Köpmanholm/Yxlan. SL bus 632 runs Norrtälje-Yxlan and serves stops across Yxlan, including Köpmanholm and Vagnsunda; bus 634 is useful for Furusund/Köpmanholm and onward Blidö logistics. Waxholmsbolaget boats can call at Köpmanholm/Yxlan on date-specific timetables, and the Nord/Syd line is a summer-only planning option. Parking on Yxlan is limited and discouraged; leave the car at home or in Furusund where possible.

sections.campingRulesDraft: No designated campsite, shelter or official tent site is confirmed for Yxlan. Treat camping only as cautious allemansrätten use: small, discreet, one night where legal and appropriate, away from homes, gardens, cultivated land, village areas, ferry/harbor infrastructure, private shoreline plots and sensitive shore or bird areas. Do not expose the lighthouse or northern Köpmanholm as campsite facilities. Pack out waste. Use only established fire/grill places where permitted, never on rocks, beaches or open terrain, and check current fire bans; stricter fire bans can prohibit fixed grill places too.
utilitiesDraft: Services are sparse for a 20+ km section. Carry drinking water and food from Furusund/Köpmanholm, and treat Köpmanholms Lanthandel as an opening-dependent shop/food stop, not a public water point.

Köpmanholms Lanthandel / Grill & Bar / Nina's kiosk is the main shop/food/conditional-resupply candidate and SAT points hikers there for local map/info. Iterations 2-4 found current operator/social evidence for small year-round grocery/convenience and grill/bar service, with March 2026 activity and sale-listing/open-year-round evidence, but opening, grill/bar availability and future ownership should be checked before relying on it.

No confirmed public drinking-water refill was found in iterations 1-5. Private Hamnviken water taps/pumphouses appear to be association/member infrastructure and should not be exposed as public water.

Hamnholmen toilet is OSM/Wikimedia-backed with 2025 check metadata and Hamnviken rules mention a torrdass, but local association context makes public-access wording sensitive; keep it as a cautious dry-toilet candidate.

No public guest-harbor showers, waste stations, sopmaja pins or water services comparable to Furusund were confirmed on Yxlan. Norrtälje has mapped sopmajor for temporary visitors generally, but no specific Yxlan sopmaja was text-confirmed; pack out waste and do not use private bins.

Östervikens badplats is an official Norrtälje bathing place with beach, benches/tables, fireplace and parking but no toilet, kiosk/cafe, changing room, jetty or ladder; dogs are not allowed at public bathing places May 15-September 15.

Yxlö brygga grillplats and Hamnholmen toilet remain useful community/map-supported facilities with source caveats. Hamnvikens badplats and Hamnviken outdoor gym should be suppressed from final facilities.

The top-level official section metadata list still says 24.0 km because it mirrors the stale SAT card; downstream integration should prefer the section's current 22.4 km value plus conflict note.
Keep Moderate as app-facing difficulty, but preserve the contradiction that the current PDF/export labels the route difficult. Do not promote to Challenging.
Do not label the southern access point with the generic [59.604, 18.815] coordinate as Vagnsunda. Use 'southern Yxlan bus-return options on SL 632; choose stop based on how far south you hike.'
SL 632 is the Yxlan cross-island bus. SL 634 is useful for Furusund/Köpmanholm/Blidö logistics but does not serve southern Yxlan stops like Hamnviken or Vagnsunda.

Waxholmsbolaget line 27 wording must stay cautious: the current PDF is shoulder-season only, valid 2 Apr-18 Jun and 17 Aug-1 Nov 2026, with some on-request/no-fixed-time calls. Nord/Syd is a summer planning option and needs current planner/timetable verification.
Do not call the lighthouse the endpoint. It is a mapped out-and-back visit; follow the mapped route both ways and do not cut through the housing community.
Road ferry wording is correct as access metadata only: Furusund-Yxlan, 600 m, 4 minutes, free, with no WC/service implication.

Köpmanholms Lanthandel remains exposed but not as guaranteed full grocery or public utility. Operator posts show March 2026 activity and sale-listing material says open year-round, but hours/ownership/grill availability remain caveated.
Östervikens badplats remains high-confidence official swimming/fireplace/picnic/parking, but must carry negative utility metadata and should not override SAT's general Yxlan parking warning.

Hamnholmen toilet should be downgraded to cautious medium confidence. OSM is fresh and detailed and Hamnviken rules mention a dry toilet, but no official SAT/Norrtälje confirmation was found and association context weakens public-access certainty.

Yxlö brygga grillplats remains exposed only as simple medium-confidence grill/rest spot, not official municipal infrastructure and with no water, toilet, firewood, maintenance or legal-fire guarantee.
Hamnvikens badplats should be demoted hard or suppressed as facility. If retained, it is research-only/cautious local swim/rest POI, not official/public bathing place or utility.
Hamnviken outdoor gym should be research-only/suppressed unless the app supports low-confidence activity POIs.
Public drinking water, showers, public harbor services, route waste stations/sopmaja, road-ferry toilets and guest-harbor service claims remain suppressed.
NVAA listing Köpmanholm Kiosk for food-waste bags is only bag pickup, not visitor waste disposal; do not expose as waste station.
Kasberget/Jungfruringen remains user-facing near Köpmanholm/start; use OSM coordinate if tying to OSM and add fragile/archaeological wording.
Träsket remains approximate scenic lake context only, not access point, campsite, swim spot or water source; do not encourage the old lake loop.
Yxlan/Vadholmen lighthouse remains viewpoint/cultural POI, never camping, and requires no-shortcut/housing-community wording.
Stortallen and Telegrafberget remain narrative-only until stable coordinates are verified. Avoid confusing Telegrafberget with better-known SAT Telegrafberget references on other islands.
Villages and private/cottage communities remain narrative context only, not tap-to-visit POIs.
remainingQuestionsForNextIterations: Final iteration should produce a compact final app-shaped Yxlan recommendation.
One last pass should check whether Hamnviken should be fully suppressed rather than kept as low-confidence research-only POI.
Re-check shop opening/ownership as current as possible for a static caveat, not hardcoded hours.
Confirm final citation set and ensure community-sourced facilities are visibly caveated.

iterationSummaries.focus: Final Yxlan synthesis: route/access sanity, final facility set, utilities/camping/safety wording, POI policy and compact app-shaped record.
keyFindings: Final Yxlan route facts remain 22.4 km, about 6 hours, Moderate as SAT taxonomy, linear north-to-south from Köpmanholm, with a note that the current export labels the route difficult and the SAT page still shows 24 km.
The beaver issue is a completed August 8, 2025 route change, not an active closure; the old southern lake loop should not be encouraged.

Use southern bus-return wording rather than a fixed endpoint. SL 632 is the cross-island Yxlan bus; SL 634 is only Furusund/Köpmanholm/Blidö logistics. Waxholmsbolaget line 27 and Nord/Syd remain date-specific planning options.
The lighthouse is an out-and-back mapped destination and not the endpoint; do not cut through the housing community.
Final exposed facility set should be exactly four entries: Köpmanholms Lanthandel, Östervikens badplats, Yxlö brygga grillplats and Hamnholmen toilet.
Köpmanholms Lanthandel is shop/food/conditional resupply/map-info with customer-context toilet only and no public water claim.
Östervikens badplats is official municipal swimming/fireplace/picnic/rest/parking with explicit negatives: no toilet, drinking water, kiosk/cafe, changing room, shower, jetty or ladder.
Yxlö brygga grillplats is a medium-confidence community/crowdsourced simple grill/rest spot with no water/toilet/firewood/maintenance/legal-fire guarantee.
Hamnholmen toilet is a medium-confidence simple dry toilet, OSM/Wikimedia-backed and not official SAT/Norrtälje-confirmed; no handwashing and cautious public-access wording.

Hamnvikens badplats is suppressed from final facilities; at most it can be an internal/optional low-confidence local swim/rest POI if the app later supports that nuance. Hamnviken outdoor gym is removed/suppressed.

No public drinking-water refill, public shower, public guest-harbor service, route waste station/sopmaja, ferry-terminal toilet, road-ferry toilet, designated campsite, shelter, lighthouse camping or northern Köpmanholm camping should be exposed.

Final map POIs: Kasberget/Jungfruringen labyrinth, Träsket as approximate natural POI, and Yxlan/Vadholmen lighthouse. Stortallen, Telegrafberget and villages/cultural landscape are narrative-only until stable public coordinates/sites are verified.

Final safety wording should mention strict fire-ban checking, no fires on rocks/beaches/open terrain, dogs leashed March-September, municipal-bath dog restriction May 15-September 15, algae caution, ticks/TBE context, narrow-road caution, and packing out waste.

sections.name: Rowboats Finnhamn - Ingmarsö
sections.estimatedTime: 2 minutes official one-way crossing; allow substantially more time if the boats need balancing
sections.routeShape: point-to-point water connector between the Finnhamn and Ingmarsö SAT sections

routeGeometryDraft.source: Outdooractive GPX and Google My Maps KML linked from official SAT page, checked on 2026-04-26
notes: The official route is a 400 m crossing, but a solo party may need to row three crossings to leave one boat on each side.
Outdooractive/SAT GPX and Google My Maps KML expose the same six-point line. OSM/photo landing coordinates differ by only a few meters.
Explore Archipelago's generic rowboat POI marker is near Idholmen and should not replace the two endpoint landing coordinates.

sourceConflicts.summary: Official SAT lists the connector as 0.4 km. Outdooractive lists about 0:02 h for the one-way boat trip, while Komoot lists about 00:06 and the official instructions may require three crossings for a solo party.
sourceConflicts.preferredTreatment: Store 0.4 km as the official section distance, but use safety/logistics wording that tells hikers to allow extra time for the three-crossing boat-balancing procedure.

sourceConflicts.summary: The latest official SAT news, published 2026-04-23, says the rowboats are back in place and will be taken up at the end of October. Some crowd/community sources describe May-November or May 1-Nov 10 availability.
sourceConflicts.preferredTreatment: Use the current official SAT news as authoritative for 2026 and tell users to recheck SAT before relying on the crossing, especially near spring launch and late October removal.

sourceConflicts.summary: Sources variously describe the western side as Ingmarsö, Kålgårdsön or Kålgårdsön Nature Reserve, and the eastern side as Finnhamn or Idholmen.
sourceConflicts.preferredTreatment: Use paired labels: Finnhamn / Idholmen landing and Kålgårdsön / Ingmarsö landing.

sections.descriptionDraft: A short but operationally important Stockholm Archipelago Trail transfer where hikers row between the Finnhamn and Ingmarsö sections. The crossing runs between Idholmen on the Finnhamn side and Kålgårdsön on the Ingmarsö side. It should be presented as a seasonal rowboat connector, not as a normal walking section.

integrationRecommendationDraft.secondaryDistanceNote: Solo parties may need to row about 1.2 km total when balancing the two-boat system.
integrationRecommendationDraft.facilityPolicy: Keep facilitiesDraft empty. Move adjacent Idholmen/Finnhamn toilets, waste and fire/barbecue candidates to sat-finnhamn, and Kålgårdsön/Bockviken candidates to sat-ingmarso.
integrationRecommendationDraft.fallbackPolicy: If boats are unavailable or conditions are unsafe, do not cross. Use SL/Waxholmsbolaget live planning via Finnhamn, Norra Ingmarsö or Södra Ingmarsö; keep Strömma/Cinderella suppressed unless live booking for the exact date shows those stops.
integrationRecommendationDraft.safetyPolicy: Do not imply supplied PFDs, rescue equipment, lighting, shelter, toilets, water or other landing facilities. Recommend daylight, settled conditions and self-reliant preparation.

sections.gettingThereDraft: The connector is reached from the adjacent Finnhamn and Ingmarsö trail sections. Finnhamn, Norra Ingmarsö and Södra Ingmarsö are served by Waxholmsbolaget on date-specific timetables; 2026 PDFs checked for lines 10, 12 and 13 are valid 2 Apr-18 Jun and 17 Aug-12 Dec 2026, with some departures or stops requiring booking. Those static PDFs leave 19 Jun-16 Aug outside the checked line 10/12/13 windows. SAT's Swedish Finnhamn page says NordSydlinjen runs 22 Jun-16 Aug 2026 and follows a large part of SAT, but the accessible static s40 PDF found in iteration 4 was still the 2025 timetable, so treat Nord/Syd as planner-verified summer access only. Current 2026 Strömma/Cinderella timetable material found in iteration 4 did not list Finnhamn or Ingmarsö.

accessMetadataDraft.name: SAT rowboat crossing system
accessMetadataDraft.description: Two Skärgårdsstiftelsen rowboats connect Finnhamn/Idholmen and Kålgårdsön/Ingmarsö. They are only for crossing between the trail sections, not for excursions. There must always be one rowboat on each side.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Finnhamn / Idholmen rowboat landing
accessMetadataDraft.description: Eastern rowboat landing on the Finnhamn/Idholmen side. Official GPX/Outdooractive, Trippa, OSM and Wikimedia converge around this location.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Kålgårdsön / Ingmarsö rowboat landing
accessMetadataDraft.description: Western rowboat landing on Kålgårdsön, the Ingmarsö-side connection. Official GPX/Outdooractive, the Ingmarsö/Finnhamn map PDF, OSM and Wikimedia support this landing area.

accessMetadataDraft.name: 2026 rowboat seasonal status
accessMetadataDraft.description: Official SAT news published 2026-04-23 says the rowboats are back in place and will be taken up at the end of October. Treat the crossing as seasonal and recheck official SAT updates before relying on it.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Ferry fallback planning
accessMetadataDraft.description: If the boats are missing, unsafe or weather makes rowing unsuitable, do not cross. Use SL/Waxholmsbolaget planning for alternatives via Finnhamn, Norra Ingmarsö, Södra Ingmarsö, Åsättra, Boda, Vaxholm or Stockholm. Lines 10, 12 and 13 have current 2026 shoulder-season PDFs checked in iteration 2; some departures or jetties may require advance booking.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Strömma/Cinderella static access suppression
accessMetadataDraft.description: Do not present Strömma/Cinderella as a static 2026 Finnhamn/Ingmarsö access option. The current 2026 public timetable checked in iteration 2 covers the Sandhamn corridor and does not list Finnhamn, Norra Ingmarsö or Södra Ingmarsö. Only use if a live booking/planner result for the user's exact date shows those stops.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Nord/Syd summer caveat
accessMetadataDraft.description: SAT's Swedish Finnhamn page says NordSydlinjen runs 22 Jun-16 Aug 2026 and follows a large part of SAT. The accessible static s40 PDF found in iteration 4 was still the 2025 timetable, and likely 2026 PDF variants returned 404. Treat Nord/Syd only as a possible summer planning option if the current SL/Waxholmsbolaget planner shows it for the user's date.

accessMetadataDraft.name: SAT non-urgent problem report
accessMetadataDraft.description: For non-urgent SAT trail problems around the connector, such as blocked route, unclear markings or blocked landing, email ProblemsOnSAT@gmail.com with a photo if possible, exact location and a short description.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Skärgårdsstiftelsen visitor fault report
accessMetadataDraft.description: For non-urgent broken, dirty, damaged or unsafe infrastructure on Skärgårdsstiftelsen land, use Skärgårdsstiftelsen's visitor fault-report form or contact Skärgårdsstiftelsen. This is not an emergency channel.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Finnhamn operations local contact
accessMetadataDraft.description: Finnhamns Arkipelag AB lists +46 8 542 462 12 and info@finnhamn.se as contact details. OSM notes report this as a local contact if rowboats are missing for more than 30 minutes, but this specific use case was not confirmed on an official SAT page and it is not an emergency number.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Emergency number 112
accessMetadataDraft.description: Call 112 only for urgent emergencies: danger to life, property or the environment, such as a person in the water, injury, hypothermia, inability to reach shore safely, fire or suspected wildfire.

sections.campingRulesDraft: No camping or shelter claim belongs to the rowboat connector. Apply adjacent reserve and allemansrätt rules on Finnhamn/Kålgårdsön; pack out waste, use public toilets where available, keep dogs leashed where required, and follow all fire bans.
utilitiesDraft: No public toilet, drinking water, shop, cafe, shelter, campsite, lighting, lifebuoy, bench or bin was confirmed as part of the connector itself after iteration 2.

Nearby Finnhamn and Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön amenities should be attached to their respective section records. Länsstyrelsen confirms toilets/fireplaces on Finnhamn generally, and SAT Finnhamn step-by-step confirms Pojkarnas Udde barbecue spots, but this does not make them connector facilities.
The rowboats are transport infrastructure, not rental boats or a leisure-excursion facility.
No official source confirmed lifejackets/PFDs, bailers or emergency equipment at the boats; do not imply they are provided.
waterSourcesDraft: No drinking water source was confirmed at either rowboat landing.
Carry water from confirmed points on Finnhamn or Ingmarsö rather than relying on the connector.
notesDraft: Always leave one rowboat on each side. A solo party may need to row across, tow the opposite boat back, leave one boat at the start side, and row across again.
Pull the boat onto land, tie it securely, turn it upside down and secure the oars after use.
Do not overload the boat and do not use it for private excursions.
Avoid the crossing in darkness, strong wind, poor visibility, thunder, ice, cold-water risk or if the boat, oars or rope are damaged.
No official source confirms lifejackets/PFDs are provided; bring or wear your own PFD if needed.

Plan the crossing in daylight; treat the landings as unlit and without verified rescue equipment or shelter. Use OSM negative tags to suppress false facility icons rather than as detailed user-facing facts.

Practical reports say the Finnhamn/Idholmen side can be harder to find and that boats may contain rainwater, so use the official SAT map/GPX near western Idholmen and allow time to empty the boat if needed.
If a rowboat is missing, damaged, unsafe, or the landing is blocked, do not cross. Use SAT/Skärgårdsstiftelsen reporting for non-urgent issues; call 112 only for urgent danger.
Official SAT notes that the Ingmarsö track on Kålgårdsön was updated in July 2025 and differs from Båtluffarleden, so do not assume all older Båtluffarleden descriptions exactly match SAT.

pendingFacilityDraft.reason: OSM and Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön map context suggest a dry toilet near Bockviken/Kålgårdsön, but it is not clearly part of the connector and should be verified during the Ingmarsö section pass.
OSM/community data suggest a firepit/picnic area near Bockviken, but reserve rules and section ownership point toward Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön, not this connector.

OSM suggests a toilet near the Finnhamn-side landing and Länsstyrelsen confirms toilets on Idholmen generally, but this should be attached to Finnhamn rather than the connector unless later integration supports adjacent-section amenities.
OSM suggests waste disposal near the Finnhamn-side landing, while SAT asks hikers to take waste back to the mainland; attach to Finnhamn only if later official/source checks support it.
SAT Finnhamn step-by-step confirms barbecue spots at Pojkarnas Udde, but they belong to the Finnhamn section unless later research shows direct connector relevance.

facilitiesToSuppressDraft: Any toilet, drinking water, shop, cafe, shelter, campsite, lifebuoy, lighting, bench or bin as guaranteed at the rowboat landings.
Any rental/leisure boat framing; the rowboats are only for trail-section transport.
Komoot or other guide labels such as rest area as evidence of serviced facilities.
Older Cinderella-to-Finnhamn guidance as current 2026 access unless verified in the live Strömma planner for the trip date.
Nord/Syd/line 40 timetable times from the accessible 2025 s40 PDF as current 2026 static data; use current planner or a verified 2026 timetable instead.
The broader Båtluffarleden day-hike distance as the SAT connector distance.
Any statement that public lifejackets/PFDs, bailers or emergency equipment are provided at the rowboats until confirmed.
OSM capacity=3 as an official SAT capacity limit; keep only as crowd-sourced internal context.
A detailed user-facing list of OSM negative tags such as no bench/no bin/no shelter; use them mainly to suppress false icons and prefer concise safety wording.
Finnhamn operations phone as an emergency number or official SAT missing-rowboat channel.

iterationSummaries.focus: Second-pass connector validation: reserve/amenity ownership, safety equipment, current ferry fallback, Swedish practical reports and app-shaped update.

keyFindings: No nearby amenities should be promoted to facilitiesDraft. The connector remains a seasonal rowboat transfer/access object with zero exposed facilities.

Explore Archipelago's generic rowboat POI marker is near the Idholmen side and should not replace the two endpoint landing coordinates.

Newer 2025-2026 guide/travel sources and current guidebook listings confirm the Ingmarsö-Finnhamn rowing experience is recognized, but many describe the broader Båtluffarleden rather than the 0.4 km SAT connector.

iterationSummaries.focus: Final integration pass for the connector: compact app-shaped treatment, safety/logistics wording, ferry fallback policy, source hierarchy and adjacent-facility assignment.
keyFindings: The final recommendation is to model this as a transfer connector / special seasonal water crossing, not as a normal hike section with facilities.
Use the official SAT distance as 0.4 km one-way crossing. Store the possible solo three-crossing burden as a logistics note of about 1.2 km total, not as the official distance.

Use seasonal-active-as-of-2026-04-23 as the static 2026 status. SAT's official update says the boats are back in place and planned to be removed at the end of October, but integration should still require a live SAT/status check.

Use the SAT/Outdooractive/Google My Maps six-point water line and endpoints: Finnhamn/Idholmen [59.482110, 18.804459] and Kålgårdsön/Ingmarsö [59.481047, 18.798495]. OSM landing nodes are close corroboration, not the primary geometry source.
Keep facilitiesDraft empty. No official source confirmed connector toilets, drinking water, shop, cafe, shelter, campsite, lighting, lifebuoy, bench, bin, supplied PFDs or rescue equipment.

Move adjacent Finnhamn/Idholmen toilets, waste, fireplaces/barbecue spots, shop, hostel, restaurant, campsite and guest-harbor services to the sat-finnhamn pass. Move Kålgårdsön/Bockviken and Ingmarsö amenities to sat-ingmarso after separate verification.
The rowboats are transport infrastructure for crossing between SAT sections. Do not frame them as leisure rentals or excursion boats.

Keep the one-boat-each-side rule prominent. If only one boat is on the starting side, hikers may need to row across, retrieve/tow the other boat back, leave one boat at the start side and row across again.
After use, hikers should pull the boat ashore, tie it securely, turn it upside down and store the oars under the boat. Allow time to bail rainwater if needed.

Safety copy should be concise and self-reliant: bring/wear a PFD if needed, cross in daylight and settled conditions, and do not cross in strong wind, poor visibility, darkness, thunder, ice, cold-water risk or with missing/damaged boat, oars or rope.
Use OSM negative tags such as no lifebuoy, no lighting, no bench, no bin and no shelter mainly to suppress false icons. Do not present them as official SAT facility facts.
Do not publish OSM capacity=3 as an official SAT limit; official wording only supports a do-not-overload warning.

Waxholmsbolaget is the reliable public-transport fallback. Lines 10, 12 and 13 have checked 2026 shoulder-season PDFs, but users must plan exact dates in SL/Waxholmsbolaget because some stops/departures are request-based or booking-dependent.
Nord/Syd/line 40 is a summer planner note only: SAT says Nordsydlinjen runs 22 Jun-16 Aug 2026, but the accessible static s40 PDF checked during research was still the 2025 timetable.
Suppress Strömma/Cinderella as static access for this connector. Current 2026 Strömma Sandhamn timetable material found did not list Finnhamn, Norra Ingmarsö or Södra Ingmarsö.

For non-urgent route problems, use SAT's report-a-problem workflow. For broken/damaged/dirty Skärgårdsstiftelsen infrastructure, use Skärgårdsstiftelsen fault reporting. Finnhamn operations can remain a medium-confidence local non-emergency contact, and 112 is only for urgent danger.
Older Båtluffarleden blogs/maps remain useful practical context but should not override current SAT geometry after the July 2025 Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön route update.

Skärgårdsstiftelsen: manager/landowner layer for fault reporting, general fire/service guidance and management responsibility; do not let it override Länsstyrelsen legal rules.
Finnhamn operator: best source for commercial services such as krog, lanthandel, Ragnars kiosk, guest harbors, sauna and cottage/stugby water context; treat hours as volatile.
STF/Naturkartan: good for hostel/accommodation and broad seasonal service wording; guest facilities remain guest-context unless another source confirms public use.
Waxholmsbolaget/SL: primary transport source. Static PDFs are acceptable only inside validity windows; app copy should still point to live planning for exact dates and request stops.
Explore Archipelago: useful semi-official practical layer, especially campsite service text and POIs, but below SAT/Länsstyrelsen/operator for conflicts.

OSM/Wikimedia/Grillplatser/blogs/Komoot/AllTrails/Wikivoyage: coordinate/photo corroboration, conflict discovery and practical hints only; do not promote to official rules, opening status, public service entitlement, water reliability or canonical route geometry.

geometrySourceNotes: The official H25 GPX is named SAT Finnhamn H25, uses Outdooractive route id 328873945, has metadata timestamp 2025-10-20T10:34:58.250Z, 697 trackpoints, and computes to about 10.033 km.
The older SAT Finnhamn Final PDF/Outdooractive route id 286923928 reports 9.8 km and appears to be the source of the distance conflict.
Google My Maps/KML still uses a Final-like container title but includes both the older Final and newer H25 geometries.
Iteration 4 geometry QA found the H25 KML line matches the official H25 GPX within about 1 m, while the older Final geometry diverges most near the Lammudden/southwest Jolpan area by about 130 m.
Do not import H25 embedded metadata blindly: H25 KML metadata reportedly says 2:45 and 19 m ascent/descent, while the official SAT page/step-by-step/PDF keep 3:45 and 42 m.
officialStepSegments: Steamboat quay to T-junction before Lilla Jolpan via hostel: 750 m
Lilla Jolpan loop: 2.1 km, technical coastal/rock section, clockwise
T-junction to Sindra's Trail: 800 m, slightly technical at start
Sindra's Trail to Paradisviken: 1.1 km through pasture, forest and rock slabs
Paradisviken to Idholmen loop via farm: 3 km, including farm, north-view coastal trail, rowboat meadow and Pojkarnas Udde
Paradisviken back to steamboat quay: 1.2 km via trail, boardwalk and gravel road
navigationNotes: Official guidance follows the first two loops clockwise and then hikes Idholmen as a figure-eight / counterclockwise farm loop.
SAT markings use blue/yellow ribbons and arrows with a reflective center line. Markings are closer together at unclear junctions and more sporadic where the path is obvious.
Sindra's Trail crosses pasture; close gates, keep dogs leashed, expect grazing animals and expect wet ground in spring.
The rowboat connection toward Ingmarsö should remain linked to the separate sat-rowboats-finnhamn-ingmarso connector record.
accessibilityAndShortcutNotes: Partial gravel-road accessibility only, not full trail accessibility. SAT says the gravel road from the quay reaches services, Paradisviken, Idholmen and the farm/farm shop; the farm is about 1.8 km from the quay.
The main SAT route includes technical coastal paths, rock slabs, forest paths, pasture gates and wet spring sections, so stroller/wheelchair users should be routed onto gravel-road variants only.

Useful shortcuts include skipping Lilla Jolpan at the T-junction near the hostel, staying on the gravel road instead of Sindra's Trail to reach Paradisviken, returning from Paradisviken to hostel in about 600 m or quay/restaurant in about 1 km, and taking the shorter westward Idholmen route toward the rowboats instead of the full farm loop.

sections.descriptionDraft: Moderate 10.1 km SAT hub section from Finnhamn brygga, looping across Stora Jolpan, Lilla Jolpan and Idholmen. Present it as a flexible island hike with gravel-road shortcuts, rocky shoreline, forest and meadow paths, pasture gates, beaches, viewpoints, Idholmen farm and summer services near the quay/hostel cluster. Several loops can be shortened back toward the hostel, restaurant, shop and ferry.
sections.gettingThereDraft: The primary trailhead is Finnhamn ferry jetty, stopRef 824, reached by Waxholmsbolaget and planned through SL/Waxholmsbolaget. Finnhamn is reachable from Åsättra on Ljusterö year-round according to SAT, and SAT also describes Stockholm/Vaxholm access, but the published Waxholmsbolaget 2026 PDFs checked for lines 10, 12 and 13 cover 2 Apr-18 Jun and 17 Aug-12 Dec 2026 only. Some departures and jetties require advance booking/request in the SL app, on Waxholmsbolaget's website or via customer service; SAT FAQ also reminds hikers to raise the pier semaphore. SAT's Swedish Finnhamn page says Nord/Syd runs 22 Jun-16 Aug 2026, but the accessible static s40 PDF found was still 2025 and no current static 2026 line 40 PDF was found in iteration 5, so treat Nord/Syd as planner-verified summer access only. Åsättra is the strongest year-round mainland transfer claim per SAT, but exact bus/ferry dates still need live verification. Boda and Lillsved are valid transfer corridors when line 13/12 patterns are active; keep bus details planner-only. Suppress Strömma/Cinderella as static Finnhamn access unless a live exact-date search shows the stop. Private water-taxi fallback candidates such as Rederi Gällnö, Gula Båten and Finnhamns sjötaxi should be note-only fallback options when booked/quoted in advance and conditions allow, not scheduled public access. Edö Båttaxi should not be listed as active because its own site says operations are paused.

sections.campingRulesDraft: Finnhamn nature reserve rules are the primary camping source. On Idholmen, Stora Jolpan and Lilla Jolpan, camp only at designated tent sites. In other reserve areas, do not camp for more than two consecutive nights. For app UX on this section, show designated tent areas only. Do not surface generic AllTrails/Komoot wild-camping claims.
utilitiesDraft: Länsstyrelsen confirms accessible toilets at the steamboat quay, on Idholmen and at the hostel, plus dry toilets/sopmaja in several places.
The tent-area water pump at [59.476425, 18.817320] is the strongest hiker-relevant water candidate after iteration 2; no official year-round guarantee was found.
Stugby hand pumps around [59.481605, 18.811287] and [59.481764, 18.810204] are plausible water points but partly guest/service-cluster context and should stay caveated.
Paradisviken and Vandrarhemsviken harbor water/electricity are boater infrastructure bought through OHOY and should not be exposed as free public hiker water.
Waste/sopmaja points exist at guest harbors and service clusters, but the app has no waste facility type and SAT's low-impact advice still supports taking waste back to the mainland where possible.
Hostel showers/toilets, sauna sea-water shower and stugby shower should not be exposed as free public utilities; they belong to guest, camper or booked-service contexts.
No public laundry facility was confirmed through iteration 2.

notesDraft: This is a service-rich archipelago hub in summer, but many services are seasonal or guest/boater-context services.
Dogs must be leashed all year in Finnhamn nature reserve; do not treat the route as off-leash dog-friendly.
Fires are allowed only at designated fireplaces and only when no fire ban applies. Never light fires or grill directly on rocks.
Use fixed grills/common grills and charcoal/briquettes where required; do not burn branches or dead wood from the reserve.
Stay on marked paths where possible and do not damage rock, soil, trees, dead wood, plants, mosses, lichens or fungi.
Pasture sections require care around grazing animals: keep distance, leash dogs and close gates.
Terrain includes uneven roots, rocky shoreline, wet spring sections, boardwalks and slippery rock slabs after rain.
Treat bathing spots as natural/open-water bathing unless managed safety services are explicitly confirmed.
Plan outbound and return ferries before starting, and avoid relying on the last ferry connection.
If continuing to Ingmarsö, check rowboat status and weather before leaving the main Finnhamn loop.
H25 geometry is preferred for the route line, but the older 9.8 km PDF/Outdooractive route remains a stale official-source conflict until SAT republishes the print map.
For public hiker water, prefer the tent-area pump and caveated stugby pumps. Do not treat paid harbor water or booked/guest-service showers as public trail utilities.

Partial accessibility exists on the gravel road from quay to services, Paradisviken, Idholmen and farm, but the full SAT loop is not accessible because of technical coast, rocks, roots, pasture gates and wet sections.
Tick/TBE awareness is relevant in season; Stockholm coastal areas are a known TBE-risk context and tick checks are prudent from spring to autumn.
Treat swimming as unsupervised open-water swimming. Avoid green/murky algal-bloom water and use caution around rocks, cold water and boat traffic.

Wikivoyage-style claims that wind shelters are overnight shelters and that guest-harbor water is always readily available should be suppressed or rewritten because they conflict with reserve camping rules and paid harbor-water evidence.
Use green hand pumps where operational, but keep seasonal/operability caveats and tell hikers to carry water outside the main service season unless current water access is confirmed.
Iteration 4 coordinate QA found all current POI pins well aligned with the H25 route; Lammudden sits off-route and should remain an optional side-trip, while Talludden stays pending/internal.

Private water-taxi fallback candidates for Finnhamn are Rederi Gällnö, Gula Båten and Finnhamns sjötaxi, but these are paid booked/quoted services and should remain note-only rather than accessMetadata records. Do not list Edö Båttaxi as active.
Do not store exact commercial date/hour bands as normalized app data for Finnhamn. Use summer/seasonal/check-current-opening labels; exact hours belong only in source notes if needed.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Finnhamn section research: official route facts and geometry, facilities/services, access logistics, reserve rules/safety and secondary practical sources.
keyFindings: Finnhamn is a moderate loop/hub section across Stora Jolpan, Lilla Jolpan and Idholmen, starting and ending at Finnhamn ferry jetty.
Use 10.1 km as the SAT public-page value for now, but retain the conflict with the official PDF/Outdooractive value of 9.8 km and linked GPX computed distance around 10.03 km.
The route is best represented as flexible linked loops: Lilla Jolpan, Sindra's Trail/Stora Jolpan and an Idholmen figure-eight/farm/rowboat-side loop.
The main service hub is around Finnhamn brygga, Finnhamns Krog, the lanthandel/summer shop and STF/Finnhamns Vandrarhem Utsikten.
June-August is the reliable full-service window. Operator pages found in iteration 1 still showed 2025 hours for food/shop/kiosk, so exact 2026 hours need rechecking.

Länsstyrelsen confirms accessible toilets at the steamboat quay, Idholmen and the hostel, dry toilets/sopmaja in several places, fireplaces at the tent area, near the hostel and on Idholmen, designated camping and year-round Waxholmsbolaget access.
Camping on Idholmen, Stora Jolpan and Lilla Jolpan should be shown as designated-site only, despite generic camping/wild-camping labels on some secondary platforms.
Dogs must be leashed all year in the reserve, which is stricter than SAT's generic seasonal dog-leash wording.
Water sources need a second pass: campsite/stugby water is likely hiker-relevant, while guest-harbor water/electricity may be paid or boater-context infrastructure.
Pojkarnas Udde barbecue spots can be promoted to Finnhamn rather than the rowboat connector because official SAT step-by-step confirms them on the Idholmen loop.
Wind shelters need disambiguation: SAT confirms a wind shelter detour, but OSM/community sources show several candidates whose official status and overnight intent are not yet clear.

Waxholmsbolaget/SL is the primary public access. Nord/Syd should be planner-verified summer-only until a 2026 static s40 timetable is found, and Strömma/Cinderella should be suppressed as static Finnhamn access.
Rederi Gällnö may be a medium-confidence private water-taxi fallback if booked in advance and ice-free; Edö Båttaxi should not be listed as active because its site says operations are paused.

Resolve exact toilet, sopmaja and water pins, separating public hiker facilities from paid/guest/boater services.
Recheck whether Finnhamn operator pages have 2026 hours for the krog, lanthandel, Ragnars kiosk, sauna and farm shop.
Verify exact public coordinates and source quality for the two tent areas.
Disambiguate Lilla Jolpan/Lammudden/Talludden wind shelters and decide whether any are app-facing overnight shelters or only rest/weather POIs.

Look for a current 2026 Nord/Syd/line 40 PDF or rely solely on planner wording.

iterationSummaries.focus: Final-quality cross-check before synthesis: current commercial services, campsite/shelter/water contradictions, access/timetable status, app-copy/suppression pass and geometry/POI QA.
keyFindings: The commercial-service posture remains intentionally cautious. Finnhamns krog, lanthandel, Ragnars kiosk, rentals and Idholmens gård are real seasonal services, but the operator food/shop page checked on 2026-04-26 still explicitly labels the restaurant schedule as 2025 and mixes undated/current date bands elsewhere.

The sauna is stronger than before as a paid bookable service: iteration 4 found current 2026 booking availability on the operator product page, but no stable fixed public hours. Keep it as booked/paid, not a public utility.

Keep both Södra and Norra tent-area pins only with caveats. The user-facing rule should be 'camp only at designated tent areas'; Södra remains the primary service-rich tent area, while the exact north/south split stays medium-confidence unless an integration map can represent sub-areas cleanly.

The facility contradiction audit supports keeping toilets, water pumps and fireplaces already drafted, while continuing to use Länsstyrelsen for broad authority and OSM/community pages only for exact coordinates or conflict discovery.

SAT/Explore support public hiker water at green hand pumps and especially the tent-area pump, but pump operability and winter reliability are not static facts. Paid OHOY guest-harbor water remains suppressed as free hiker water.

Wind shelter treatment is settled unless the app lacks a rest/weather shelter type: Lilla Jolpan is an on-route rest/weather shelter, Lammudden is an optional side-trip shelter/fireplace, Talludden remains pending/internal, and none should be advertised as overnight accommodation.

Access audit reconfirmed Waxholmsbolaget/SL as the only strong static public-transport source. Lines 10/12/13 have 2026 shoulder-season PDFs covering 2 Apr-18 Jun and 17 Aug-12 Dec; Nord/Syd line 40 should stay live-planner wording because the accessible s40 PDF remains 2025 despite SAT listing 22 Jun-16 Aug 2026.

Åsättra is the strongest mainland transfer node, Boda is a valid secondary transfer through line 13, and Lillsved should remain planner-only for bus details even though ferry-side access appears in lines 12/13.

Private fallback candidates now include Rederi Gällnö, Gula Båten and Finnhamns sjötaxi, all as paid booked/private transport only and not scheduled public access.

Current POI coordinates are well aligned to H25: Paradisviken, Idholmen farm, Utsikten, Lilla Jolpan lookout, Sindra's Trail, Jordgubbslandet, Pojkarnas Udde and Lilla Jolpan shelter all fall within roughly 1-21 m of the H25 track; Lammudden is off-route and optional.

The central gravel-road network lets hikers shorten between Norra/Södra quays, the service hub, B&B and bakery without committing to the full Femsund/Kålgårdsön trail.

sections.descriptionDraft: Ingmarsö is an easy SAT island section linking the ferry quays at Norra and Södra Ingmarsö with the service hub, Femsundsbadet, forest and pasture paths, Kålgårdsön nature reserve and the rowboat connection toward Finnhamn. Present it as a flexible local loop/connector: accessible gravel-road variants cover much of the inhabited island, while the Femsundsbadet and Kålgårdsön trail sections add wet forest, pasture gates, boardwalks and more technical ground.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Use Waxholmsbolaget/SL as the canonical access layer. Norra Ingmarsö is served by line/table 10 from Åsättra and by line/table 12 from Stockholm/Vaxholm/Lillsved patterns; Södra Ingmarsö is served by line/table 13 from Stockholm/Vaxholm/Boda patterns. Current PDFs for lines 10, 12 and 13 are valid 2 Apr-18 Jun 2026 and 17 Aug-12 Dec 2026, leaving a summer timetable gap from 19 Jun-16 Aug 2026 that must be planned live. SL 626 to Åsättra is valid 14 Dec 2025-18 Jun 2026; SL 438 to Boda is valid 14 Dec 2025-18 Jun 2026 and 17 Aug-12 Dec 2026. Use live planning for summer, disruptions, holiday changes, ticket validity and request/booking stops; some request stops require booking in the SL/Waxholmsbolaget app, web or customer service before the deadline shown in the timetable. Do not say normal SL tickets cover Ingmarsö; ticket validity depends on ticket type, route, season and area. Raise the pier semaphore when waiting for pickup. Nord/Syd line 40 should remain planner-only until a current 2026 static timetable is found, and it is only indirectly relevant via Finnhamn rather than Ingmarsö itself. Strömma/Cinderella should not be static access unless exact-date live booking shows Ingmarsö. Private water taxis are note-only fallbacks after active-status verification.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Ingmarsö section research: official route facts and geometry conflicts, facilities/services, access logistics, reserve rules/safety and secondary practical sources.
keyFindings: SAT public page lists Ingmarsö as Easy 9.8 km and startable from either Norra or Södra Ingmarsö, with counterclockwise marking recommended.

Official sources conflict materially: SAT step guide says Easy 9.5 km / 3.5 h / 75 m ascent, while current V26 Outdooractive/PDF says about 9.4 km / 2:25 / 72 m ascent / moderate. Explore/OSM/AllTrails are longer and should not be route-distance authority.
Use SAT Ingmarsö V26 as likely current geometry but preserve conflicts until a dedicated geometry pass. SAT's 2025-07-18 route-change notice says the section page and on-site marking are correct.
The route is best represented as a lollipop/branched island section linking Norra and Södra quays, Femsundsbadet and the Kålgårdsön rowboat-side trail, not a simple point-to-point line.
Older Båtluffarleden material is practical context only because current SAT leaves and rejoins Båtluffarleden on Kålgårdsön after the route update.
Södra Ingmarsö is the main service hub: guest harbor, Coop/year-round shop, Ingmarsö Krog, bakery, fuel/boat services, waste context and bike rental cluster.
SAT confirms toilet and water at Ingmarsö Gästhamn, not in winter. Expose seasonal water/toilet with caveats and suppress paid/guest harbor services as free public hiker utilities.
Kålgårdsön reserve rules control the eastern route segment: dogs must be leashed and camping is forbidden except at any designated places. No designated tent site was confirmed.
Bockviken has medium-confidence scenic/rest and toilet/firepit candidates from map/OSM/community sources, but the firepit and toilet remain pending until official/current confirmation.

Access should be modeled through Waxholmsbolaget/SL nodes: Norra Ingmarsö, Södra Ingmarsö, Åsättra, Boda/Lillsved and the separate rowboat connector. Line 40/Nord-Syd remains planner-only and Cinderella remains suppressed.

Safety UX should include the dangerous boatyard waterfront at Södra, pasture gates/grazing animals, partial accessibility only, rowboat/weather warnings, fire-ban/rock-fire caution and tick/TBE awareness.

keyFindings: Geometry pass resolved the canonical distance in favor of official V26 geometry: GPX has 442 points and computes to about 9.378 km, while the KML is about 9.366 km. Use 9.4 km as app distance, but retain SAT public page 9.8 km and step guide 9.5 km as official conflicts.
Use Easy difficulty and about 3:30 visible time from SAT page/step guide. Keep Outdooractive/PDF 2:25 and platform Moderate/T1 as metadata conflicts rather than user-facing values.
V26 is an open branched/lollipop section from the Kålgårdsön rowboat side to the Femsundsbadet junction via Norra/Södra Ingmarsö, not a simple closed loop.

Ingmarsö Gästhamn should remain a seasonal harbor service cluster, not a general public utility hub. Include only SAT-relevant seasonal toilet and water, with tighter OSM-supported coordinates and not-in-winter/paid-harbor caveats.

Guest-harbor shower, sauna, laundry, power, waste sorting, bike rental and harbor fees are paid/guest/marina services. Keep them suppressed or note-only unless the app grows a marina or paid-rental layer.

Commercial services are active and useful but seasonal/volatile: Coop is the stable year-round resupply node with staffed plus unstaffed/hybrid access; Ingmarsö Krog and Ingmarsö Bageri are stable seasonal food nodes; Norrgården/Ingmarsö B&B is booking-dependent accommodation/heritage context.
Norrgården service house and tent-place are only planned for the 2026 season as of this check, so they stay pending/suppressed until confirmed operational.

Kålgårdsön reserve rules remain app-facing: dogs leashed, no camping except at designated places, no official designated campsite found. Bockviken bathing rocks can remain a natural rest/swim POI; Bockviken toilet/firepit/picnic tables stay pending because no official confirmation was found.

Femsundsbadet is stronger than a generic natural swim POI: Österåker's 2025 municipal page says it is a public bathing place with bottom checks and water-quality checks. No useful Ingmarsö/Kålgårdsön/Femsundsbadet Naturkartan item was found. Keep Naturkartan suppressed as an Ingmarsö-specific source for now.
