Clarify whether individual swimming POIs should be facilities or POIs in final integration and whether any HaV/municipal water-quality status applies.
Confirm exact names and coordinates for the northwest viewpoint and any Lilla utsikten candidate.
Check for AED/emergency metadata sources on Grinda; none were added in iteration 1.
Validate final Grinda object against app-safe types and guard policies after each iteration.

iterationSummaries.focus: Second Grinda pass: route-geometry conflict reconciliation, access/ticket caveats, stricter facility public/customer boundaries, POI/rule verification, exact grill/campsite coordinates and emergency metadata.
keyFindings: Keep current official SAT public facts as canonical for display: Moderate, 9.8 km, 3:30, 55 m gain and clockwise island loop.

Distance conflicts are now sharper: SAT step-guide subsegments sum to 9.4 km, the 2025 GPX computes to about 8.87 km, Google KML contains about 8.103 km and 8.812 km lines, Outdooractive lists 8.9 km/94 m and the older 2024 PDF lists 8.1 km/138 m.

OSM relation 19079703 and Wikidata Q133502246 corroborate 9.8 km / clockwise / roundtrip metadata, so secondary structured sources support the current SAT headline even though downloadable geometry artifacts differ.

Södra Grinda remains the primary SAT start/end and busiest pier. Norra Grinda remains a real but secondary/fallback access point, suitable for variants/exits and requiring exact-date timetable checks.

Current 2026 Strömma/Cinderella material serves Södra Grinda seasonally and separately ticketed. Broader Länsstyrelsen wording about both piers and Cinderella should be treated as stale/general unless current operator timetables prove it.
Grinda operator access pages confirm low-season Waxholmsbolaget travel from 14 September to 29 April accepts SL period tickets valid 30 days or longer; this applied on the 2026-04-26 check date.
Länsstyrelsen supports promoting a Södra Grinda dry toilet, but not Södra drinking water. Södra water remains guarded as an unverified candidate.
Guest-harbor and Sea Lodge water/toilet remain SAT-confirmed but must carry fee/customer/seasonality caveats because operator pages frame several utilities as harbor, lodging or customer services.
Add seasonal food services Grinda Bakery and Framfickan by the guest-harbor hub; keep opening-hours and weather/season caveats.
Exact maintained grill coordinates were confirmed for Södra Grinda and the tent-site/camping area; both remain tied to designated-place and fire-ban restrictions.
Use the stricter reserve dog rule: dogs leashed year-round on Grinda, despite broader SAT seasonal leash wording.
A defibrillator is documented at Grinda Wärdshus in SAT low-season material; it is emergency metadata only, not a renderable trail facility or POI.

Check if current 2026 summer s11/s13 Waxholmsbolaget static PDFs appear; until then, keep planner/app caveat for 2026-06-19 to 2026-08-16.
Confirm whether current 2026 Cinderella/Strömma material has any Norra Grinda service, or keep Södra-only.

Check whether Källviken, Badviken and Södra Grinda dry toilets should be separate toilet facilities or left as beach-context notes.

Do not infer drinking water from dry-toilet or bathing-place points. Södra/bathing-place water remains guarded pending official/operator confirmation.

Check whether guest-harbor water should become guarded pending metadata if the final app cannot display paid/limited context.

iterationSummaries.focus: Final Grinda QA: active source links, app integration mapping, factual consistency, coordinate/proximity audit and final residual-risk synthesis.
keyFindings: No duplicate Grinda IDs or implausible off-island coordinates were found in access, facilities, POIs, secondary POIs, pending facilities or emergency metadata.

sections.descriptionDraft: Sandhamn is an easy 8.1 km clockwise SAT loop from Sandhamn ferry quay on Sandön. It moves from the harbor village into sandy pine forest and open-coast beach terrain, with Trouville and other beaches, village heritage, and several seasonal food and lodging services close to the start/end. Treat services as strongly seasonal, and keep camping, fires, marina utilities and AEDs behind verification guards.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Primary public access is Waxholmsbolaget/SL ferry to Sandhamn brygga, most reliably planned via SL bus 433/434 to Stavsnäs Vinterhamn and Waxholmsbolaget line 16 to Sandhamn. Rechecked 2026-04-26 Europe/Stockholm: Waxholmsbolaget line 16A/16B PDF v16 is current for 2026-04-02 to 2026-06-18 and 2026-08-17 to 2026-12-12, updated 2026-03-27, with request/no-fixed-time caveats. Static summer PDFs for line 15, line 16 and Nord/Syd line 40 still resolve to 2025 static PDFs, so summer 2026 public access must be live-planner verified. Strömma/Cinderella has a current 2026 Stockholm-Sandhamn timetable from 2026-04-30 to 2026-09-27 depending period/day, with separate tickets and prebooking. Separate-ticket/bookable services such as Stavsnäs Båttaxi/Sandhamn Line and Roslagens Sjötrafik/Sandhamnspilen are useful fallback or paid access options, not core public-transport metadata.

sections.accessibilityDraft: The Sandhamn route is officially Easy but not guaranteed accessible. It includes harbor/village lanes plus sandy pine-forest paths, beach/dune sections and uneven coastal/forest paths. Ferry boarding, sand, weather, seasonal services and sparse marking can all affect accessibility.
sections.campingRulesDraft: Do not render a campsite. SAT says there are no campsites on Sandhamn. No Sandön-specific nature-reserve camping ban was verified in iteration 2, so if text is needed use allemansrätten baseline cautiously: avoid homes/private land, fragile dunes/beaches and large groups; do not promote Sandön as a designated camping area.

rulesDraft.text: Do not mark Sandön/Sandhamn as a nature reserve. Naturkartan treats Sandön as a nature-value/walking area, not a reserve; nearby Svartkobben is a separate off-loop reserve.
Pack out garbage, preferably back to the mainland; use public harbor waste only if clearly public and necessary, and never private bins.
Keep dogs leashed March-September per SAT guidance; national extra-supervision baseline is 1 March-20 August.
Respect fire bans; do not light fires on rocks, terrain or beaches. Do not infer public fire permission from OSM firepit/barbecue points unless an official local source confirms them.
The route is sparsely marked because of many landowners; keep to route/paths and avoid wandering into private property.

utilitiesDraft: Primary public hiker utilities are the harbor public toilet/water at about [59.2879099, 18.9170226] and the mapped beach toilets at Trouville and Fläskberget.
KSSS guest-harbor water, showers, waste, fuel and electricity are marina/boat-guest infrastructure unless a later pass verifies free public hiker access.
Westerbergs Livs is the main village resupply candidate but requires Tempo-app/self-service access outside staffed hours.
Village food/lodging services are clustered near the ferry quay and should be rendered with strong seasonal/current-hours caveats.
waterSourcesDraft: Primary refill: public harbor toilet/water at [59.2879099, 18.9170226], about 100 m east of Sandhamn ferry quay; SAT and OSM support 08:00-20:00.
Do not treat KSSS dock water as public hiker water: KSSS frames it as guest-harbor/desalination water with limited production and max 50 liters per boat.
Do not plan a Fläskberget refill. Only OSM currently tags drinking_water=yes there; local sources confirm toilets/facilities, not drinking water.
notesDraft: Sandhamn is the village and Sandön is the island; use both names carefully in descriptions.
The loop passes harbor village, sandy pine forest, exposed sea views, Trouville, Västerudden, cemetery/chapel context and back through the village.
Village-wide pilot/customs history is important context but is better represented by the Tullhuset/museum POI plus description text than by a separate no-coordinate POI.
Do not apply Blekinge/Karlskrona Sandhamn Natura 2000 SE0410225, Sandhammaren reserve in Skåne/Ystad, Gotska Sandön/Fårö facts or Svartkobben rules to the main SAT Sandhamn loop.

Official KML/PDF/Outdooractive remain stale or noncanonical conflict artifacts. The KML/PDF Outdooractive lineage diverges on the eastern/southeastern approach toward Trouville, where the route-change/private-property/construction reroute matters.
No independent proof was found that Sandhamn information boards were replaced after autumn 2025; only updated trail markings and planned board replacement should be claimed.
Access/timetable caveats are unchanged from iteration 2: v16 is current for spring/autumn 2026, while s15/s16/s40 remain 2025 or unavailable and SAT Nord/Syd remains a live-check/source-gap item.
Stavsnäs Vinterhamn remains non-rendered mainland access metadata, now with excludeFromMapBounds and a generic metadata-only access guard.
Harbor toilet/water and Trouville toilets are route-side and keep app-facing status; Fläskberget toilet is near-route. Fläskberget drinking water remains suppressed because only OSM confirms it.
Ankaret was demoted from app-facing facilities to pending metadata because no strong current 2026 operator page was verified.
Strindbergsgården remains pending until after the future 2026-06-13 opening and renewed open-status verification.
KSSS marina services, fire/grill candidates, camping/shelter claims and private/generic waste remain suppressed.
Default POI density was reduced to five primary POIs: Trouville beach cluster, Västerudden, Kvarnberget, Tullhuset/Sandhamns museum, and Sandhamn cemetery/chapel heritage cluster.
Fläskberget, Skärkarlshamn, Lilla Trouville and Sandtaget moved or remain in secondary POI metadata to avoid over-pinning the short 8.1 km loop.

JSON QA fixes applied: bbox expanded south for Lilla Trouville, secondary render policies normalized, service-cluster references updated, bakery homepage added, and Sands bistro claims guarded because the direct bistro URL returned 404.
remainingQuestionsForNextIterations: Overlay the preferred GPX against satellite/cadastral context around the east/southeast private-property reroute before final route-geometry import.
Run final source-link hygiene for third-party POI/history sources, especially Stockholmshamnar, Sandhamn.org, Trippa, church PDF, Restaurants10 and Cafekartan.
Recheck whether 2026 summer Waxholmsbolaget s15/s16/s40 or SAT Nord/Syd updates appear after 2026-04-26.
Verify Sands bistro public opening source if the record should say more than hotel/service candidate.
Recheck Ankaret direct/current operator evidence; keep pending unless verified.
Recheck Strindbergsgården after 2026-06-13 before making it app-facing.
Decide whether secondary POIs should be imported into the app at all, or kept only as description/context.

iterationSummaries.focus: Sandhamn correction-only pass: bbox and geometry guards, access wording, POI coordinate/source alignment, stricter facility suppression and integration-risk notes.
keyFindings: The routeGeometryDraft bbox east edge was too narrow for the official GPX/OSM/KML eastern leg; it was expanded to east 18.934 with south 59.2733.
Third-party route-platform guard was strengthened: AllTrails, HiiKER, Naturkartan and Komoot are conflict-discovery sources only and must not drive Sandhamn distance, time, difficulty or geometry.

Access wording was tightened: s15/s16/s40 currently resolve to 2025 static PDFs, not 2026 schedules or 404s. Sandhamn Line and Roslagens/Sandhamnspilen are separate-ticket/bookable services, not core Waxholmsbolaget/SL metadata.
Stavsnäs Vinterhamn excludeFromMapBounds remains required because it is a mainland transfer hub and would otherwise pull Sandhamn map bounds far west.
Västerudden coordinates were aligned to the cited OSM node rather than a nearby shoreline centroid, avoiding coordinate/source mismatch.
Dog wording was tightened from should to must for the SAT-specific March-September leash rule.

Lilla Trouville source support was improved with the Sandhamn beaches page; the second Trouville toilet was downgraded to OSM-only specific evidence because local sources support toilet availability in the area but not two distinct toilets.
Fläskberget water suppression was strengthened: do not plan a Fläskberget refill, because only OSM tags drinking_water=yes while local sources confirm toilets/facilities only.

KSSS ordningsregler is now treated as negative evidence for fire/grill candidates, since it bans grilling on docks. All fire/grill candidates stay suppressed unless a non-marina official public source appears.
Sands remains a guarded hotel/service food candidate; no reliable drop-in bistro hours were added because direct bistro paths returned 404.

Integration notes now warn that draft arrays must be explicitly promoted by an importer, routeGeometryDraft.bbox must be read or copied, the Drive GPX viewer URL must not be used directly as runtime geometry, and AED metadata has intentionally null top-level coordinates.
remainingQuestionsForNextIterations: Final pass should verify no source URLs intended for user-facing citations are dead, blocked or weak where stronger sources exist.
Check once more whether any 2026 summer Waxholmsbolaget s15/s16/s40 or SAT Nord/Syd updates appeared after 2026-04-26.
Confirm final import mapping from draft arrays to app arrays and map bounds, including excludeFromMapBounds behavior.
Keep Ankaret pending unless direct/current operator evidence appears.
Keep Strindbergsgården pending until after 2026-06-13 and a current open-status check.
Verify AED metadata only through Hjärtstartarregistret/operator detail pages if it will be used.

routeShapeSummary: Start at Styrsvik pier and head east toward Runmarö Lanthandel.
Turn north and continue clockwise toward Långvik.
Continue toward Silverträsket, through forest and pasture, then east toward Nore.
Follow the route south from Nore, with sea/coast sections and optional Telegrafberget detour nearby.
Pass near Runmarö Varv / Solberga side, then west and north toward Runmarö hembygdsgård.
Return via chapel/school area, Restaurant Svängen, bakery/store area and back to Styrsvik.
geometrySourceNotes: Current official SAT section page and step guide list Moderate/Medel, 18.5 km, 6 hours and 85 m positive elevation; iterations 1-5 treat these as canonical.
Official PDF/Outdooractive export appears older or artifact-derived, with 17.9-18.0 km and different difficulty/ascent values.
The official H25 GPX computes to about 18.677 km, has 544 points, starts/ends at Styrsvik and is preferred as the likely current geometry source.
Naive raw GPX elevation accumulation produced about 324 m and should not be used because it conflicts with SAT's 85 m and likely reflects elevation noise.
OSM relation 19013472 and Wikidata Q133724246 corroborate 18.5 km and clockwise route identity.

sourceConflicts.summary: Official SAT page/guide, OSM relation tag and Wikidata say 18.5 km. Official PDF/My Maps artifact is about 17.9 km, H25 GPX computes about 18.68 km, Naturkartan metadata says 18.7 km while its body text says 18.5 km, AllTrails says 17.9 km, Komoot has conflicting 19.8 km and 17.5 km entries, HiiKER says 18.0 km, Gaia says about 17.4 km and an OSM-derived directory computes about 17.3 km.

sections.descriptionDraft: Moderate 18.5 km clockwise island loop from Styrsvik, mixing village lanes, gravel road, forest paths, pasture edges, inland lakes and rugged eastern/central sections. Gatan and Långvik can work as alternate ferry access only when the timetable serves them. Plan for a full island day with limited public water, seasonal services and ferry-dependent logistics.
sections.gettingThereDraft: From Slussen, take SL bus 433 or 434 to Stavsnäs vinterhamn, then Waxholmsbolaget ferry to Styrsvik on Runmarö. Styrsvik is the primary SAT trailhead. Gatan and Långvik are alternate access quays only on departures that serve them, so check the exact-date SL/Waxholmsbolaget planner before travelling; summer 2026 static tables were not confirmed in this research. Runmarölinjen is a separate prebooked supplement and does not replace the core Waxholmsbolaget access.

sections.accessibilityDraft: SAT describes parts of Runmarö as accessible from Styrsvik to the store and along some gravel roads, but the full 18.5 km loop is not stroller/wheelchair suitable. Eastern coast and central north-south sections are rugged, with forest paths, pasture crossings and uneven terrain; ferry boarding, weather and surface conditions also vary.
sections.campingRulesDraft: No arranged campsite was confirmed on Runmarö in iterations 1-5. Do not render a campsite or shelter. Use SAT/allemansrätten text cautiously: one discreet night may be possible only away from homes, gardens/hemfridszon, private docks, pastures, cultivated land, sensitive habitats and without disturbance or damage; this is not a designated facility and protected-area/local rules override.

rulesDraft.text: Carry at least 2 liters. No public drinking-water point is confirmed for Runmarö in iterations 1-5; do not use private water sources.

Fires only at designated fire pits and never on rocks, beaches or terrain; current fire bans override static data. Hembygdsgården has a grill/picnic mention in SAT material, but iterations 2-5 keep it guarded because local sources point to rentable/event use rather than confirmed public free-use.
SAT says dogs must be leashed March-September on the islands; keep dogs leashed near grazing animals and close gates.
Carry trash back to the mainland where possible. ÅVC/harbor waste points are special-purpose, not normal trail bins, and private bins must not be used.
Runmarö has high-value lime-influenced flora, wetlands and protected orchids. Keep visitors on paths and do not pick or disturb orchids or sensitive plants.

notesDraft: Use Swedish display names with diacritics, but keep ASCII IDs.
Runmarö is one of Stockholm County's floristically richest areas, especially its lime-influenced eastern habitats and wetlands.
All orchids are protected in Sweden; do not pick or disturb them.
Purren wetland is sensitive nature context and in the national mire protection plan, but no on-route visitor reserve page was found in iteration 1.
Iteration 2 geometry QA found no Runmarö-specific official route-change notice; official SAT route-change notices found were for other sections such as Ingmarsö and Sandhamn.

Iteration 4 third-party review checks suggest the route can feel easier than Moderate in dry/good conditions, but length, ferry logistics, limited water and rocky/rooty sections still justify the official Moderate difficulty.
Most land on Runmarö is privately owned and settlements are concentrated on the west/south side; avoid encouraging camping, water use or toilet use near private houses, docks, gardens or pastures.
Do not promote Båtsmanstorp nr 95 as a navigable POI because it is private property.
Do not import nearby Skötkobbarna, Nämdöskärgården national park, Telegrafberget nature reserve in Tyresö or Runnö nature reserve in Kalmar into this Runmarö walking section.

safetyWarningsDraft: Use 112 for urgent danger to life, property or environment, including sea rescue.
Carry at least 2 liters of water and do not use private water or toilet sources.
Check current fire bans; use only designated fire places and never light fires on rocks, beaches or terrain.
Walk on the left side on road sections and be cautious around local traffic.
Close pasture gates and keep dogs leashed, especially near grazing animals.
Eastern and central route sections include rugged, rocky or rooty terrain despite limited elevation gain.
Ticks/TBE, vipers and algal blooms are relevant seasonal hazards.
Jerkers udde has no facilities, no supervision and no municipal water sampling.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Runmarö research: official geometry and facts, ferry access, service/facility candidates, POIs, high-value nature/rules and JSON integration shape.
keyFindings: SAT Runmarö is canonically Moderate 18.5 km, about 6 hours and 85 m gain, with a clockwise loop from Styrsvik and possible alternate access at Gatan/Långvik.

Official H25 GPX appears to be the preferred current geometry candidate and computes about 18.68 km; older PDF/Outdooractive artifacts give shorter/different scalar values and should remain conflict evidence.
Current 2026 spring/autumn public access is Waxholmsbolaget v23 table 23A/23B via Stavsnäs, with v16/v17 related services. Summer 2026 static table was not found; s23 is still 2025.
Styrsvik is the primary trailhead; Gatan and Långvik are alternate ferry access points only when served by the chosen timetable. Stavsnäs vinterhamn remains mainland metadata only.
No public drinking water should be rendered in iteration 1. SAT recommends carrying at least 2 liters, and the Runmarö Varv/Norrviken toilet is tagged no drinking water.
The dry toilet near Runmarö Varv/Norrviken is the strongest public toilet candidate, but the SAT-provided code is stale-looking (2025) and needs current verification before exposing any code.
Runmarö Lanthandel, Svängen, Låttas bageri, Solberga Gård services and Runmarö rum are useful service candidates, mostly seasonal/customer/booking-dependent.
Hembygdsgården grill/picnic area is the only app-facing grill/fireplace candidate in iteration 1, and only with designated-place and fire-ban caveats.
Jerkers udde is a public/simple bathing-place POI, but Värmdö says it has no facilities, supervision or municipal water sampling.

High-value nature context is important: Silverträsket, Viträsket, Noreträsket, Purren wetland and lime-influenced orchid flora should shape the description and rules, not become over-promoted sensitive waypoints.

Suppress campsite, sleeping shelter, public water, customer toilets as public toilets, transit waiting shelters as hiking shelters, ÅVC as trail waste, RYC private/club facilities, Norrviken harbor services, private boatsman croft POIs and nearby/off-route reserve false positives.

routeShapeSummary: Recommended SAT start is Solvik, with grocery and seasonal food services beside the ferry quay.
From Solvik the route passes Nämdö church area and Sand, where the museum, library and seasonal public toilet/water are located.
South of Sand, the guide warns of about 1.7 km where the route is unmarked and passes close to homes; hikers should use the interactive map and respect private property.
The route heads west and north through forest toward the lake at Tjusvik, then continues through pasture toward Långvik.
At Långvik, the main SAT route returns east toward the north-south gravel road; the white-marked trail/sauna side route is optional.
The north-south road gives access north toward Östanvik and Nämdöböte or south back toward Solvik.

sections.descriptionDraft: Moderate 13.1 km multi-access island hike on Nämdö, with Solvik recommended as the clockwise start. The route mixes ferry quays, village lanes, active farm and pasture landscapes, forest paths, a quiet lake near Tjusvik, short sea-view detours and flexible exit points at several Waxholmsbolaget quays. Services are best at Solvik and Sand and are seasonal, while water/toilet details need winter caveats.
sections.gettingThereDraft: Use Waxholmsbolaget/SL as the canonical access layer. The strongest year-round mainland transfer is Stavsnäs vinterhamn, reached by SL bus 433/434 from Slussen and connected to Nämdö by Waxholmsbolaget line/table 17. Current line 17A/17B static timetable evidence is valid 2 Apr-18 Jun 2026 and 17 Aug-12 Dec 2026; summer 2026 must be planned live because current static summer PDFs still expose 2025 material. SAT recommends starting at Solvik and walking clockwise, but the section can also be started or exited at Nämdöböte, Östanvik, Västanvik, Solvik or Sand when the chosen departure serves that quay. Check request/booking symbols. Do not present Boda or Långvik as Nämdö ferry access.

sections.accessibilityDraft: SAT says several Nämdö sections can suit strollers, wheelchairs or visitors with limited mobility, especially the gravel and forest roads from northern Nämdö past Sand toward southern areas. A suggested accessible-style outing is Östanvik ferry quay past the farm/farm shop toward Solvik or Sand. The full section is not barrier-free because it includes forest paths, unmarked/private-property-sensitive stretches, pasture gates and uneven terrain.
sections.campingRulesDraft: Nämdö nature reserve allows short camping only within reserve rules and allemansrätten limits; Länsstyrelsen rules prohibit camping more than two nights in the same place. Avoid homes, private plots, agricultural meadows, grazing land, sensitive vegetation and disturbance. Östanvik/Själudden is now confirmed by Naturkartan/Värmdö as a tent site with dry toilet, waste shed and bathing, but it should still render as a managed optional/detour campsite rather than as blanket permission to camp anywhere.

rulesDraft.text: The walking section belongs primarily to Nämdö nature reserve, protected since 2002, 2,237 ha total / 500 ha land, owned and managed by Skärgårdsstiftelsen and including Natura 2000 Norra Nämdö SE0110349. Nämdöskärgården National Park is separate nearby marine context.
SAT says dogs must be leashed March-September. Nämdö nature reserve rules prohibit unleashed dogs more broadly except enclosed plots; keep dogs leashed, especially near grazing animals.

Fires are allowed only at designated places and never on rocks; current fire bans override static data. The Sand shelter/fire-pit mention needs designated-place verification before app-facing fire rendering.
Public water is strongest at Sand museum in season and not in winter. Solvik and Östanvik/Långvik water mentions require seasonal/potability caveats. Treat sea/lake water as untreated.
The route crosses pasture/electric fence near Långvik. Close gates, keep distance from cattle and avoid disturbing animals.
The step guide warns of about 1.7 km unmarked route after Sand and asks hikers to use the interactive map, respect private property and pass quickly near homes.
Stockholm County is TBE/tick-risk context. The route uses grass, bush, pasture and woodland terrain; check for ticks and consider current public-health vaccination guidance.
SAT asks hikers to take garbage back to the mainland where possible. Harbor/sopmaja points are local waste infrastructure and should not be over-promised as trail litter disposal.

Länsstyrelsen reserve rules prohibit damaging rock, soil, stone, vegetation, living or dead trees, disturbing wildlife, motor vehicles outside designated roads, aircraft landing outside designated places and boat anchoring at the same shore for more than two days.

Nämdöskärgården National Park was established in 2025, is mainly marine and has its main entrance on Bullerö. Do not apply Bullerö/national-park services or rules to the main Nämdö walking section by default.

utilitiesDraft: Best service cluster is Solvik: grocery, seasonal restaurant/bakery/pizza, ferry quay and harbor/fuel context.
Sand has the strongest official public utility note: toilet and water at the museum, not available in winter.
Solvik seasonal toilet/summer water is now corroborated by SAT and OSM, but remains seasonal and tied to the access/service spur.

Östanvik farm/farm shop is a strong seasonal POI and possible service detour; the Östanvik/Själudden tent site is confirmed but should be optional/detour-managed rather than default route-side camping.
Långvik sauna is a public Skärgårdsstiftelsen service but is a side-route/white-trail context, not a normal SAT facility marker. Långvik water remains unreliable for drinking-water rendering.
Hembygdsgårdens bodar near Sand are a lodging/service metadata candidate with booked simple huts, not a normal trail shelter or public utility.

No public charging point was confirmed through iteration 3. Solvik guest harbor/fuel belongs in service-cluster metadata only; do not infer electricity, public charging, showers, drinking water or pump-out from harbor presence.
A limited-availability AED at Nämdö Hembygdsförening/Sand was found in iteration 3 and is emergency metadata only, not a normal POI/facility.
Do not render ferry waiting shelters as overnight shelters.
waterSourcesDraft: Sand museum / Gamla skolan: official SAT says water is available, not in winter; OSM water tap is at [59.1821550, 18.6886085].
Solvik: official step guide says summer water and OSM has public toilet/drinking-water tags at [59.1849827, 18.7006724]; treat as seasonal/service-spur utility, not year-round.
Östanvik: local/Visit Värmdö/OSM sources suggest fresh water; verify current availability and potability before relying on it as a primary refill.
Långvik pump: local/OSM context exists near [59.1999134, 18.7079436], but water testing/potability is uncertain; do not render as reliable drinking water yet.
Carry enough water outside high season and do not use private wells without permission.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: 112 emergency number
emergencyMetadataDraft.description: Call 112 for urgent emergency assistance in Sweden. State the island and nearest quay/village such as Nämdöböte, Östanvik, Västanvik, Solvik, Sand, Långvik or Tjusvik.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: Djurö vårdcentral läkarbåt

Treat as booked, non-acute island medical-service context, not walk-in hiker emergency care; ice can cancel bryggmottagningar and urgent emergencies go through 112.

emergencyMetadataDraft.description: Use 1177 for non-urgent medical advice in Sweden; nurses answer day and night. From non-Swedish phones or abroad use +46 771-11 77 00. Use 112 for urgent emergencies.

safetyWarningsDraft.text: Exact-date ferry planning is essential. Some quays/departures require booking or have no fixed departure time, and summer 2026 static PDFs were not current in iteration 2.
After Sand, the official guide warns of about 1.7 km unmarked route near homes. Use the official map, stay respectful and pass quickly.
The route crosses pasture/electric fence near Långvik. Close gates and keep dogs leashed and away from cattle.
Reliable public water is seasonal. Sand museum water is not available in winter; Solvik is summer/seasonal; Långvik and Östanvik water candidates need potability/public-access verification.
Fires are only allowed at designated places and never on rocks. Do not render or rely on the Sand fire-pit mention until designated-fire status is confirmed.
The route passes grass, bush, pasture and woodland in a TBE/tick-risk region. Check for ticks after hiking and follow current public-health vaccination advice.

notesDraft: Official SAT public distance/time/difficulty remain 13.1 km, 4:30 and Moderate despite 12.8 km export artifacts.
Use mainRouteBboxFromGpx for route map bounds; the broader bbox intentionally includes off-route metadata such as Idöborg and Ängsholmen.
Solvik is the recommended start and an access/service spur, but the strict GPX passes closer to church/Sand than the quay/service cluster.
Östanvik/Själudden tent site is confirmed by Naturkartan but should be optional/managed, not default wild-camping guidance.
Nämdöskärgården National Park information belongs in context/secondary POI only; national-park islands and services are separate boat/kayak destinations.
Iteration 3 replaced the earlier AED absence note with a guarded, limited-availability AED metadata record at Nämdö Hembygdsförening/Sand.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Nämdö research across official route geometry, access/timetables, facilities/services, POIs/rules/safety and JSON schema fit.
keyFindings: Current official SAT facts are Moderate, 13.1 km, 4:30 hours and 40 m ascent. These override older/export scalar values.
Official GPX/PDF/Outdooractive artifacts report about 12.8 km; PDF duration 0:05 h is an export bug.
The section is multi-access. SAT recommends starting at Solvik clockwise, while the step guide starts at Nämdöböte and several ferry quays can serve as start/end points.

Canonical public access is Waxholmsbolaget/SL via Stavsnäs vinterhamn and line/table 17, with Solvik, Sand, Östanvik, Västanvik and Nämdöböte as relevant quays. Boda and Långvik should not be modeled as Nämdö ferry access.
Summer 2026 static ferry evidence is not settled; use live/exact-date planning for 2026-06-22 to 2026-08-16 until current static assets appear.
Strong route-side service clusters are Solvik and Sand. Solvik has grocery and seasonal food; Sand has the strongest official toilet/water note, both unavailable in winter.
Östanvik, Långvik and Idöborg contain useful service context, but many records need optional-detour/off-route or pending guards before app rendering.
Nämdö nature reserve is the main protected-area context. Nämdöskärgården National Park is nearby by boat/kayak and should not be folded into the walking section.
Reserve/private-property/pasture/fire/tick/water/waste cautions are important for user-facing notes.

sections.descriptionDraft: Long, moderate Ornö island section with two official SAT day-stage choices from Hässelmara toward Ornö church/Kyrkviken. The northern option visits Skinnardal, Ornöboda, Söderviken and Fiversätra before reaching the church area, while the southern option uses forest, hill, farm and wetland landscapes via Utsiktsberget, Bodal, Kråkmora/Lättinge, Mörby Gård and Lervassa Träsk. Services cluster mainly at Kyrkviken/Ornö church and around Brunnsviken/Lättinge; access depends heavily on ferry, bus 889 and exact-date seasonal planning.
sections.gettingThereDraft: The strongest normal access is Dalarö Hotellbryggan by SL bus, followed by Ornö car ferry/Waxholmsbolaget line 20 to Hässelmara. On Ornö, SL bus 889 links Hässelmara, Skinnardal, Ornö kyrka, Sundby and Lättinge, but departures can be sparse or conditional. Ornö church/Kyrkviken, Ornöboda and Söderviken may be served by Waxholmsbolaget line 19 or Nord/Syd on relevant dates, while Lättinge is useful but renovation-conditional in the current line 20 PDF. Plan exact dates in SL/Waxholmsbolaget and check request/booking symbols before choosing a one-way itinerary.

exportTopologyNotes: The GPX starts near Bergbrottet at 59.059491, 18.424874 and ends near Kyrkviken quay at 59.052159, 18.432916.
The route reaches Hässelmara around 15.95 km, returns near the start around 29.16 km, then continues via Ornö Church/Lervassastigen to Kyrkviken quay.
The missing final-to-start closure is about 0.94 km straight-line, which explains part of the 34.1 km public value versus 32.6 km export length gap.

routeShapeSummary: Official material treats Hässelmara as the most normal western start reached by ferry from Dalarö.
Northward option: Hässelmara, Skinnardal, Ornöboda junction/quay spur, Söderviken, Fiversätra and Ornö church/Kyrkviken.
Southward option: Hässelmara, Utsiktsberget/lookout, Bodal, Kråkmora/Lättinge decision point, Mörby Gård, Lervassa Träsk and Ornö church/Kyrkviken.
Lättinge can be used as access/exit. Iteration 1 notes about 10 km from Lättinge to Ornö church and about 8.5 km from Lättinge to Hässelmara, subject to geometry review.
The step guide recommends the 2.6 km Lervassastigen extension from Ornö church to the ferry quay when logistics require it.

requestStopSemantics.B: Trip-level booking: book in SL app, Waxholmsbolaget web or customer service at least 2 hours before departure from the relevant quay, but no later than 17:00.
requestStopSemantics.C: Trip-level booking no later than 19:00 the day before travel.
requestStopSemantics.b: Quay-level booking: book at least 1 hour before departure from the relevant quay, but no later than 17:00.
requestStopSemantics.c: Quay-level booking no later than 19:00 the day before travel.
requestStopSemantics.X: Quay is served without a fixed departure time.
requestStopSemantics.r: Lättinge quay closed through June due renovation.
requestStopSemantics.semaphore: Raise the pier semaphore to signal the boat to stop; in darkness use headlamp/flashlight. This does not replace any required B/C/b/c advance booking.

busSymbolSemantics.v889: 1) means only some departures serve the stop; b means only non-holiday Monday and Wednesday where shown. The bus PDF does not define ferry-style advance booking.

ticketSemantics.waxholmsbolagetLowSeasonSlPeriodTicket: Region Stockholm says SL tickets valid for 30 days or longer are accepted on Waxholmsbolaget during low season 14 September-29 April; do not generalize this to summer or to SL single tickets.
ticketSemantics.waxholmsbolagetSlAppTicket: Waxholmsbolaget tickets can be bought in the SL app; traveler must choose the correct Waxholmsbolaget fare/taxa and validate/blip onboard to receive the paper ticket used at disembarkation.
ticketSemantics.ornoBilfarja: Ornö Sjötrafik/Ornö ferry is separate from normal SL/Waxholmsbolaget ticket handling for O-marked/special-fare departures. Their site says vehicle places must be booked no later than 30 minutes before departure, foot passengers and cyclists do not book places, only return tickets are sold, and there is no onboard ticket handling.

sections.campingRulesDraft: SAT FAQ evidence says there are no campsites on Ornö; do not promote camping as a normal route service. Where allemansrätten camping is otherwise legal, protected-area and property rules still apply: Norra skogen prohibits camping more than two consecutive 24-hour periods, and Sundby has separate side-trip rules limiting camping/boat mooring at the same place to two consecutive days and prohibiting open fire. Never camp close to or within view of homes, farms, pasture gates, ferry infrastructure or route-side properties.

safetyWarningsDraft.text: SAT instructions include asphalt-road walking from Hässelmara toward Skinnardal and optional road walking near Ornö church/Lättinge. Walk on the left side facing traffic and be cautious.

At Svinåker and other farm/pasture passages, pass quietly and carefully through farm buildings, fences, gates, tractor tracks, fields and pasture; close every gate, keep dogs leashed, expect animals/horses/vehicles and avoid disturbing residents.

Official SAT says water/toilets are available at the museum/local heritage center and advises carrying at least 2 liters. Do not use private water sources or toilets without permission; do not treat lakes/sea/private wells as public potable water.

Archipelago fire risk is dynamic. SAT says fires only at designated fire pits and never in terrain, on rocks or beaches; no route-side public designated fire facility is confirmed for Ornö. Sundby's no-open-fire rule applies to that side-trip reserve, not the main SAT line unless a future geometry pass changes the overlap. Do not store current no-ban status; check Länsstyrelsen Stockholm, Haninge/SBFF, Krisinformation or Brandrisk Ute live.

Ticks are common in the archipelago. SAT says ticks can carry Lyme/borrelia and TBE and recommends TBE vaccination if not vaccinated. 1177 Stockholm says TBE is especially common in Stockholm, Sörmland and Uppsala coastal areas and around Mälaren; ticks are usually active March-November, with some year-round risk. Check skin/clothes after hiking and remove attached ticks as soon as possible; use 1177 for symptoms or medical advice.
A missed ferry or conditional stop can strand an itinerary. Download offline maps/timetables and confirm the return leg before starting a one-way hike.

Use stricter wording than the generic SAT March-September note: Naturvårdsverket says dogs need extra control March 1-August 20 and in practice usually need a leash; SAT says dogs should be leashed March-September; dogs should be leashed near grazing animals and sensitive wildlife. Sundby side-trip reserve explicitly requires dogs and cats to be leashed.

Hunting can occur on private island land, especially in autumn. If you see Jakt pågår signs, choose another area or route where possible; the signs do not automatically close allemansrätt-accessible land, but visitors must not disturb hunting and should make themselves visible, keep dogs controlled and calmly leave an active hunt area if encountered.

Do not assume continuous mobile coverage or data service. Download maps/timetables offline and carry written emergency/access notes. If 112 cannot be reached during a telecom disruption, Krisinformation advises trying without the SIM card so the call can use an available operator network; in larger outages emergency-call points may be designated, often at fire stations.

Several route/access points are coastal, with quays, beaches, rocks and boat traffic. 1177 warns drowning can happen quickly and quietly; supervise children at water, avoid swimming alone if ability or conditions are uncertain, use life jackets on boats and around water when needed, and avoid alcohol near water.

Keep a summer algal-bloom warning. 1177 says blooms are most common July-September and can also occur later; avoid swimming or letting children/dogs near green, murky, film-like or visibly blooming water. Do not drink bloom-affected water; boiling or desalination does not remove algal toxins. Call 1177 for suspected algal poisoning, or 112 for acute danger.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Ornö research across official geometry, access/timetables, facilities/services, rules/safety/emergency context and JSON/import fit.
keyFindings: Current official SAT public facts are Moderate, 34.1 km, 11 hours and 197 m ascent. Newer PDF/Outdooractive artifacts list 32.7 km and 10 hours, while older indexed material lists 27.4 km and 8 hours.
The route is best modeled as two marked day-stage options from Hässelmara to Ornö church, with optional full-loop use and access at Hässelmara, Ornöboda, Lättinge and Ornö church/Kyrkviken.
Official GPX/KML evidence gives route bounds around south 59.043184, west 18.36526, north 59.112044 and east 18.483656. OSM relation 19023687 and Wikidata Q133724236 corroborate the route identity.

Normal access is Dalarö to Hässelmara via line 20/Ornö ferry plus on-island bus 889. Ornö church, Ornöboda, Söderviken and Lättinge need exact-date ferry planning; Lättinge is renovation-conditional in current line 20 evidence.
Kyrkviken/Ornö church is the strongest route service cluster, with official water/toilet notes plus grocery, restaurant, bakery/deli and seasonal museum cafe candidates.

Brunnsviken/Lättinge, Sundby and Hässelmara have useful service or lodging context, but most records are seasonal, side-route, customer/booking-based or unsupported by the current app facility type model.
Norra skogen and Sundby reserve rules are important context, but their exact route overlap still needs geometry review and they must not render as POIs/facilities.
Iteration 1 found emergency context for 112, 1177, 113 13, an AED near Mörbyfjärdens IF, Ornö nurse clinic context, fire rescue context and sea rescue context. All remain metadata only.
remainingQuestions: Overlay service candidates against the official GPX to decide which are truly route-side.
Verify exact public coordinates and opening rules for Kyrkviken water/toilets.
Check 2026 opening dates for bakery, bistro, museum cafe, Sundby and Brunnsviken services.
Recheck Lättinge quay renovation and summer 2026 Nord/Syd timetable before integration.
Confirm whether any Naturkartan SAT Ornö route page exists, and whether it adds route-side utility records.

iterationSummaries.focus: Second-pass Ornö validation across geometry/proximity, facilities currentness, access/timetable status, protected-area/safety/emergency data and adversarial JSON QA.
keyFindings: Official SAT public values remain 34.1 km, Moderate, 11 hours and 197 m ascent, but iteration 2 parsed the official GPX at about 32.620 km and KML at about 32.446 km. The export behaves as an open line rather than a clean closed loop.
SAT stage split is confirmed as northward Hässelmara-Ornö Church 19 km and southward Hässelmara-Ornö Church 15.1 km.
Hässelmara, Ornöboda, Lättinge and Ornö Kyrka/Kyrkviken are true access points, but Söderviken is about 590 m from the exported route and should stay secondary access context.
Lättinge brygga closure remains active through June 2026 according to Trafikverket/Haninge and line 20 evidence; after June, use exact-date planning because summer 2026 static PDFs are still stale.

Kyrkviken/Ornö church remains the strongest route service area. Water, toilet, Ornö Macken, Kyrkvikens Bar & Bistro, Ornö Brödbod & Deli and nearby Kyrkviken bathing are the main normal facility candidates, with seasonal/current-hours caveats where relevant.

The on-route MIF/Bodal dry toilet candidate at 59.0722851, 18.3865883 is promoted to facilitiesDraft with public-access caveats. The old draft Bodal coordinate at 59.0339043, 18.3490866 is suppressed as off-route.

Brunnsviken/Ornö Båtvarv and Ornö Skärgårdshotell are about 1.0-1.25 km off route; Sundby is about 2.0 km off route; Vitträsk bath is about 1.48 km off route. Keep these as optional/metadata rather than normal route-side facilities.
Talludden shelter evidence collides with Finnhamn/Österåker. The Ornö museum-area firepit remains a guarded candidate only, not a shelter or confirmed designated fire facility.
Norra skogen reserve overlap is confirmed but small, about 0.78 km of main route, so keep rules context. Sundby reserve has no main-route overlap in the iteration 2 overlay.
Current official SSRS evidence supports nearby Dalarö/Värmdö sea-rescue context but not active RS Ornö. Hjärtstartarregistret AED record 79003 supports the MIF AED as emergency metadata only.
jsonQaFindings: Iteration 2 removed guarded records with non-empty renderPolicy from normal import allow lists and added metadataOnly/optional detour buckets.
Service clusters now include center/integrationNote fields and split Kyrkviken museum utilities from quay/food services.
Normal POI candidates now exclude unpinned route landmarks until coordinates are added; iteration 3 later pins most of these.
The current app code still ignores renderPolicy/notTrailFacility, so the contribution file remains manual-merge-only.
remainingQuestions: Find precise coordinates for Utsiktsberget, Lervassa Träsk, Fiversätra and Mörby Gård before normal POI import.
Verify exact public water/toilet access at Kyrkviken in off-season and outside building/harbor hours.
Recheck 2026 hours for Ornö Museum cafe, Brödbod, Bistro, Hässelmara farm shop, Sundby and Brunnsviken services before final app integration.
Wait for current 2026 summer ferry/Nord-Syd static timetables or use live planner only.

iterationSummaries.focus: Third-pass Ornö enrichment: POI coordinates and route order, service currentness, access booking semantics, safety refinements and importer-facing QA.
keyFindings: Official route order is now clearer: north stage Hässelmara, Svinåker, Ornöboda, Söderviken, Fiversättra, Ornö church/Kyrkviken; south stage Hässelmara, Telegrafberget/Utsiktsberget, Bodal/MIF, Kråkmora, Mörby/Lervassa turn, Lervassa Träsk north end, Ornö church and Lervassastigen/Kyrkviken.

iterationSummaries.focus: Final Ornö validation across official route facts, facilities/currentness, access/tickets, safety/emergency data and JSON/import safety.
keyFindings: No canonical route-value change is needed: live SAT page and step guide still support 34.1 km, Moderate, 11:00 and 197 m ascent, while the official PDF/Outdooractive 32.7 km/10:00/difficult conflict remains metadata.

Official GPX/KML provenance was rechecked. GPX still parses to 1580 trackpoints, metadata time 2025-03-12T15:44:01.740Z, start near Bergbrottet and end near Kyrkviken; KML still has a 592-point main line plus a separate start marker.

A final official-navigation detail was added: the early Hässelmara-Skinnardal road section is not marked with yellow/blue SAT signs until about 3.8 km from the jetty, and hikers should walk facing traffic.

Facilities/currentness review recommends no new normal-facility promotions beyond the established Kyrkviken/Bodal set. Brunnsviken, Sundby, Hässelmara, Kayakomat, Mörbyfjärden bath, Vitträsk and the museum-area firepit remain optional, metadata-only or suppressed.

sections.descriptionDraft: Sparse-service Fjärdlång island loop from the public ferry quay. The route uses gravel road, narrow SAT-marked paths, technical coastal/cliff terrain, forest/ridge trail, meadows, bays and the island high point Tysta Klint. Current official SAT guidance says hikers must be self-sufficient: no water during 2026, limited services, and the hostel temporarily closed.
sections.gettingThereDraft: The normal access point is Fjärdlång brygga. Fjärdlång is ferry-dependent and should be planned by exact date. Outside high summer, current evidence points to Waxholmsbolaget line 19 via Dalarö/Ornö east/Fjärdlång/Utö, with limited/request-based departures. For high summer, SAT currently points to Nordsydlinjen from 2026-06-22 through 2026-08-16, but no current 2026 operator static line 40 PDF was found in iteration 3. Treat 2026-06-19 to 2026-06-21, request trips, holidays, and all bus/ferry transfers as planner-only.

routeOrderDraft: Start at Fjärdlång public ferry quay.
Follow gravel road past the football field; after about 500 m turn right/south onto SAT-marked narrow trail.
Continue south, east, then somewhat north along technical coastal trail and cliffs to a ditch and small tractor road.
Optional official out-and-back east on the tractor road reaches swimming cliffs north of the garbage dock.
Continue north on tractor road, then northeast between houses and uphill across open slope to a four-way trail junction.
Thielska Villan is about 100 m left from this junction; official SAT continues right/uphill northeast.
Follow technical forest/ridge trail about 3 km to meadow by the bay.
At meadow, direct return to ferry quay is possible, but full SAT route continues west/north along the bay.
Official full route includes a short out-and-back/loop to island high point Tysta Klint, then returns south/east through rolling terrain and meadow.
Finish via football field/gravel road back to the ferry quay.

geometrySourceNotes: Official GPX/KML agree on route bounds and start/end at Fjärdlång brygga, but computed export length is about 11.4 km while public SAT value is 11.7 km.
KML contains one main LineString and a separate point marker at the route start.
OSM relation 19016280 corroborates route identity, 11.7 km tag and anticlockwise direction, but member geometry should not be used as primary route geometry without a later dedicated pass.

Iteration 2 proximity QA used official KML/GPX as primary geometry. OSM relation 19016280 confirms SAT identity, 11.7 km and anticlockwise direction, but summed OSM member ways are only about 8.725 km, so relation geometry remains non-primary.

timetableStatusDraft.summer2026StaticStatus: Final official check reconfirmed no current 2026 operator static PDF for summer line 40/NordSyd. The official print-timetable list shows passenger lines through 31 for current 2026 shoulder-season material; direct s40.pdf remains valid only 2025-06-23 to 2025-08-17, and v40/s40-2026/s40b/v40b were not found. SAT says Nordsydlinjen runs 2026-06-22 through 2026-08-16, but its linked complete timetable is still 2025 and SAT says the new timetable is updated in June each year. Use live SL/Waxholmsbolaget planning for all exact 2026 times.

timetableStatusDraft.line40NordSydStatus: Officially relevant for summer island-hopping; SAT has 2026-06-22 through 2026-08-16 date framing, but no current operator static line 40 PDF was found.

staticPdfAudit.note: s40.pdf still resolves but is 2025-dated, so it should not be cited as current 2026 summer operator evidence.

requestStopSemantics.b: Quay-level request via SL app, Waxholmsbolaget web or customer service at least 1 hour before departure from the relevant quay, no later than 17:00.
requestStopSemantics.B: Trip-level booking/request at least 2 hours before departure, no later than 17:00.
requestStopSemantics.C: Booking/request by 19:00 the day before travel.
requestStopSemantics.X: The quay is served without a fixed departure time; exact-date planning and the timetable footnote must be checked.
requestStopSemantics.z: The quay is served in reverse order.

timetableStatusDraft.requestAndSemaphoreSemantics: Keep b/B/C/request markings and pier semaphore semantics separate. A request-marked departure must be requested by the deadline printed in that specific timetable PDF; the pier semaphore only signals that waiting passengers want the scheduled boat to stop.

ticketSemantics.waxholmsbolagetInSlApp: Region Stockholm says Waxholmsbolaget tickets can be bought in the SL app; traveler must choose the correct Waxholmsbolaget fare/taxa and validate onboard to receive the paper ticket used at disembarkation.
ticketSemantics.waxholmsbolagetSlAppTicket: Waxholmsbolaget single tickets can be bought in the SL app, but the traveler must choose the correct archipelago ticket and validate onboard according to Waxholmsbolaget instructions.
ticketSemantics.lowSeasonSlPeriodTicket: Region Stockholm says SL tickets valid for 30 days or longer apply on Waxholmsbolaget during low season 14 September-29 April. Do not generalize this to summer or to SL single tickets.
ticketSemantics.waxholmsbolagetLowSeasonSlPeriodTicket: Low-season SL period-ticket validity is access metadata only and should not be shown as a durable trip promise outside its stated season/date range.
ticketSemantics.currentFareCaveat: Do not hardcode a Fjärdlång fare. Current Waxholmsbolaget single tickets are distance-based in six fare categories; adult range SEK 61-186 and concession range SEK 39-114 on the official fare page. The journey planner gives the correct fare for a specific origin/destination.
ticketSemantics.slValidityCaveat2026: As of the iteration 4 check, SL says a 30-day-or-longer SL travelcard is valid on all Waxholmsbolaget services only through 2026-04-29 in the current low-season window. Year-round all-SL-ticket validity applies only within the defined Strömkajen-Vaxholm/Rindö inner area, not as a general promise for Dalarö-Fjärdlång.

timetableStatusDraft.fallbackTransportPolicy: Keep BOUT and Dalarö sea taxi/charter as guarded fallback metadata only. They are useful if public ferry timing fails, but should not render as scheduled public access or official SAT access unless a booking/date result is verified.
timetableStatusDraft.exactDateGapCaveat: Treat 2026-06-19 through 2026-06-21 as an explicit planner-only gap: v19/v20/v21 static PDFs end 2026-06-18, SAT's Nordsydlinjen window starts 2026-06-22, and Midsummer/holiday traffic warnings require live verification.

sections.accessibilityDraft: Moderate 11.7 km island loop with ferry-dependent access, sparse services, technical coastal/cliff paths, forest/ridge trail, meadows and no drinking water in 2026. Do not present as generally accessible without a dedicated audit.
sections.campingRulesDraft: Fjärdlång is both a nature reserve and a Natura 2000 site. Do not present blanket wild-camping freedom. Reserve rules prohibit tenting or mooring a boat in the same place for more than two consecutive days. Tenting at an indicated place in the southern Fjärdlång managed/leased area may follow manager/tenant instructions, but current SAT guidance says the hostel is temporarily closed and hikers must bring their own food and accommodation. Treat campsite operation and any fee/service details as facilities-currentness questions, not general allemansrätt permissions.

rulesDraft.name: Fjärdlång nature reserve rules
rulesDraft.description: Nature-reserve rules prohibit damaging natural formations, damaging living or dead trees/shrubs, deliberately disturbing wildlife, bringing dogs/cats/other pets unless leashed, tenting or mooring more than two consecutive days in one place, open fire, and motor craft over 7 knots within 100 m of land except public fairway. Southern-area camping/fire exceptions are manager/tenant-instruction exceptions, not general public trail permissions.

rulesDraft.name: Fjärdlång Natura 2000 context
rulesDraft.description: Fjärdlång is Natura 2000 site SE0110086 under the Habitats Directive/SAC framework, not a confirmed SPA in current public data. EUNIS says Birds Directive/SPA: No and SAC designated 2011-03-01. Naturvårdsverket proposed Fjärdlång as a new marine SPA, but consolidated NFS material still shows SE0110086 with Habitat Directive status and no Bird Directive date. Keep SPA wording as proposed/pending only.

rulesDraft.name: Fjärdlång reserve management currentness
rulesDraft.description: Länsstyrelsen's live facts now list Skärgårdsstiftelsen and USF-Ö Fastighet AB as landowners/managers. The 2025-12-17 decision revoked Haninge municipality's management appointment for Fjärdlång 1:18 and transferred that part to USF-Ö Fastighet AB for a five-year trial, to be reconsidered by 2030-12-17; Fjärdlång 1:1 and 1:16 remain with Skärgårdsstiftelsen. The published reserve-rule exception text still mentions Haninge's lease wording, so app copy should say current manager/tenant instructions rather than Haninge as current operator.

rulesDraft.name: Ängsön-Marskär bird-protection rules

rulesDraft.name: Seasonal shore-fishing restriction

Store as rules metadata only and do not expose as a walking-route POI.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: 112 emergency number
emergencyMetadataDraft.description: Use 112 only for acute emergencies where life, property or environment is in danger, including ambulance, fire/rescue, poisoning advice, environmental rescue at sea and sea rescue. State Fjärdlång plus nearest quay, bay, trail landmark, route section or side of the island. SOS operators speak Swedish or English and can use interpreters; callers should still describe location clearly and give coordinates from the 112 app/map when possible.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: 1177 medical advice
emergencyMetadataDraft.description: Use 1177 for non-urgent medical advice. For acute symptoms, serious injury, drowning/hypothermia, severe allergic reaction or suspected serious tick/algal symptoms, use 112.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: 113 13 crisis information
emergencyMetadataDraft.description: 113 13 is for verified information during major accidents or crises, not urgent help.

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: Fire rescue context near Fjärdlång

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: Sea rescue context near Fjärdlång

emergencyMetadataDraft.name: AED source policy for Fjärdlång
emergencyMetadataDraft.description: Do not add a mapped AED for the Fjärdlång route without live Hjärtstartarregistret/112-app verification. Public registry/WFS check in iteration 4 found no visible public AED on the main Fjärdlång island loop; the closest visible 24/7 registry point found was Fiversätraö brygga, across water/off-route, not a route AED. A 2025 Wikimedia image at [59.036306, 18.512828] documents a broken Fjärdlång AED/sign, which is negative evidence against rendering that point as usable. In cardiac arrest, call 112 first and follow dispatcher/app guidance.

safetyWarningsDraft.text: Open fire is prohibited in Fjärdlång nature reserve. The exception is for places designated by the current manager/tenant in the southern leased/managed area for camp-school/managed activity; it is not a general public trail-fire permission. Do not render firepits as normal facilities. Check Länsstyrelsen Stockholm/Krisinformation/Brandrisk Ute/SBFF for temporary fire-ban status, and distinguish any stove advice from the reserve's stricter local rules and on-site signs.

Dogs, cats and other pets must be leashed in Fjärdlång nature reserve year-round. This is stricter than SAT's March-September note and Naturvårdsverket's national March 1-August 20 wildlife-control period.

SAT's current step guide says there is no drinking water during 2026. Hikers should carry all water from the start, at least 2 liters and more in warm weather. Do not infer water from the closed/uncertain hostel/camping context.

Fjärdlång is ferry-dependent and low-season access is limited to some days. SAT explicitly warns not to miss the return ferry. Carry offline maps, timetable notes, food, water, warm/rain layers and a power reserve.

Ticks are common in archipelago grass/forest. 1177 says TBE is especially common in Stockholm, Sörmland and Uppsala coastal areas and around Mälaren; tick season is usually March-November with some year-round risk. Check skin/clothes after hiking and remove ticks promptly. Use 1177 for advice and 112 for severe neurological/allergic symptoms or acute illness.

Keep summer algal-bloom warnings for bathing cliffs and sheltered brackish bays. 1177 says blooms are most common July-September and may occur later; avoid green, murky or visibly blooming water, especially for children and dogs, because toxins can affect people and pets. Use 1177 for advice and 112 for severe symptoms.

Fjärdlång reserve and nearby skerries include sensitive bird and shoreline restrictions. Do not encourage landing or side trips to Ängsön-Marskär/Myggskär-area restricted skerries during protected periods; keep this as rules context rather than attraction content.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Fjärdlång research across official route facts/geometry, facilities/services, access/logistics, safety/rules/emergency context and JSON/import fit.
keyFindings: Current SAT public values are 11.7 km, Moderate, about 3.5 hours and 79 m elevation gain. Official PDF/Outdooractive and computed GPX/KML length are closer to 11.4 km and 4:00 h, so those are stored as conflict metadata.
Route is a counter-clockwise island loop from Fjärdlång brygga, with gravel road, technical coastal/cliff trail, forest/ridge paths, meadows, bay-side walking and a high-point visit to Tysta Klint.

Current official SAT guidance says no water during 2026, the hostel is temporarily closed and hikers need their own food/accommodation. This suppresses older or conflicting service evidence for water, hostel, cafe, kiosk, shop and lodging.
Dry toilets are the only normal facility candidates in iteration 1: a Sandviken/Thielska cluster, Vedviken and southeast Mörkviken. Coordinates and grouping need later verification.
Camping, firepits, rentals, Norrötorpet, Myggskär cabins and harbor/boating infrastructure stay conditional, future-layer or metadata-only records.

Primary access is Fjärdlång brygga via Waxholmsbolaget line 19 outside high summer and seasonal Nord/Syd line 40 in summer. Summer 2026 static PDFs remain unverified/stale, so exact-date live planning is required.

Fjärdlång nature reserve rules prohibit open fire, unleashed pets, wildlife disturbance and more than two consecutive days of tenting/mooring at one place; bird-protection and seasonal shore-fishing restrictions are off-main-loop rules context.
Emergency context remains metadata-only: 112, 1177, 113 13, SBFF/Haninge rescue context, SSRS Dalarö/Värmdö sea rescue and an AED source policy with no web-verified on-island AED.

sections.name: Utö
sections.routeShape: counterclockwise loop from Gruvbryggan or Spränga Brygga across Gruvbyn services, the campground, Spränga, Södra Fladen wetland, the technical eastern coast via Rävstavik and Kroka, Barnens bad, then back to Gruvbryggan
sourceHierarchyDraft: Official Stockholm Archipelago Trail Utö section page and step-by-step guide.
Current operator pages for Utö Gästhamn, ICA, Utö Värdshus, Waxholmsbolaget and SL.
Länsstyrelsen Stockholm and Skärgårdsstiftelsen/Naturkartan for reserve rules and public outdoor services.

OSM/Wikimedia only for coordinate corroboration and low-risk detail, not as sole promotion for water or emergency facilities. Outdooractive Utö URLs are stale or blocked after iteration 4 and should be treated as provenance/conflict evidence only.
Forum/blog material may explain visitor experience but should not override official currentness.

notes: Utö has far more services than many SAT islands, so the main risk is over-importing commercial or boating-only infrastructure as hiking facilities.

Iteration 2 found the SAT-linked current GPX measures about 18.42 km, supporting the official 18.4 km route page and making the older 16.7/16.8 km PDF/Outdooractive/OSM values likely stale or alternate-geometry evidence.
Public toilets and campsite evidence is strong; water-pump and AED evidence needs later live/registry verification.

Iteration 3 independently reproduced the official GPX provenance: the SAT Utö page links Google Drive file 1SiHBiKvOTbvOyUe_xHxYfqBmQk1JNWdn, direct download https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1SiHBiKvOTbvOyUe_xHxYfqBmQk1JNWdn, metadata/trk name SAT Utö H25, timestamp 2025-10-20T10:12:09.494Z, 1,893 points, and 18.422 km 2D haversine length.

Iteration 4 found several Naturkartan object URLs for Barnens bad and Rävstavik returned raw HTTP 404 despite search-index traces. Treat them as brittle archival evidence only and prefer official Utö/Länsstyrelsen/SAT plus OSM/Wikimedia corroboration in final source lists.
Iteration 4 found the old Outdooractive Utö Final URL gone and the newer Outdooractive route link blocked/unstable; keep Outdooractive only as GPX metadata/provenance, not as a live route source.
Iteration 4 confirmed Försvarsmakten Utö shooting-field PDFs rotate by week; cite the stable parent page/RSS and require live checks rather than freezing old direct PDF links.

Iteration 5 found the direct SAT-hosted GPX URL https://stockholmarchipelagotrail.com/app/uploads/2025/11/t328873047_sat-utoe-h25-1-1.gpx in addition to the Google Drive copy; it has the same SAT Utö H25 metadata, 1,893 trackpoints and about 18.422 km 2D length.

Iteration 5 kept all current normal candidates, with Rävstavik north toilet still medium-high because its durable source stack is OSM plus Wikimedia while Naturkartan remains brittle/search-index evidence.

descriptionDraft.short: A challenging Utö loop with the trail's densest service hub at Gruvbryggan, mining heritage, wetland birdlife, rocky east-coast hiking, cliff bathing and shallow sandy beach stops.
descriptionDraft.long: Utö functions almost like a compressed SAT sampler: ferry village, shop, inn, harbor, old mining landscape, campground, wetland boardwalk/rest area, technical coastal rock, open sea views, pasture, Kroka and Barnens bad. The route is best handled counterclockwise so hikers leave the service cluster, pass Spränga and Södra Fladen, then take the harder eastern coast before the easier final return.
doNotOverstate: Do not imply Spränga Brygga has services; SAT explicitly says it has none.
Do not present the whole island as free camping; the reserve allows camping only at designated places.
Do not market southern Utö/Storsand as a route facility because the shooting-field access context is separate from SAT.

gettingThereDraft.primary: Year-round public access is via Waxholmsbolaget line 21 between Årsta brygga and Utö, with Gruvbryggan as the serviced SAT trailhead and Spränga Brygga as an alternative no-service access point.
gettingThereDraft.landConnection: SL bus 846 links Västerhaninge station with Årsta brygga; the SL PDF states the timetable is adapted to commuter trains.
gettingThereDraft.seasonal: SAT states Nordsydlinjen runs June 22-August 16, 2026 and links Utö with Nåttarö, Ornö and Fjärdlång, but exact 2026 static timetable evidence still needs revalidation.
gettingThereDraft.ticketing: Use Waxholmsbolaget/SL live planners near travel date; line PDFs seen in iteration 1 have a 2026 summer gap.

measurement.method: WGS84 haversine sum over consecutive GPX trkpt coordinates; 2D length used because raw elevation deltas are noisy
measurement.decision: Use this GPX as the current precise geometry baseline; it rounds to the official 18.4 km section length.

kmlContext.description: Google My Maps KML contains both old S A T Utö Final and SAT Utö H25; document text says 18.5 km, but the simplified H25 line has fewer points and measured about 17.99 km.

routeGeometryDraft.segmentDistanceStatus: Official step-by-step segment distances still sum to 16.7 km and are useful for route narrative, but iteration 5 treats them as stale for total distance because the current main page and GPX support 18.4 km.

officialSegments.surface: gravel road, trail and rocky terrain
officialSegments.notes: Passes ICA, campground service building and a signed Russian baking oven side curiosity; SAT continues left where marked.

officialSegments.name: Spränga Brygga to Vänsviken/Södra Fladen
officialSegments.notes: Passes the church turnoff, school and Hembygdsgården before the wetland, bird tower/rest area and embankment.

officialSegments.name: Along the eastern coast to Kroka

officialSegments.notes: Most demanding part; Rävstavik, Södra Sandvik and multiple sea-view benches/context points.

officialSegments.name: Kroka to Barnens bad
officialSegments.surface: some gravel road, mostly technical trail
officialSegments.notes: West/Mysingen side before the shallow sandy beach at Barnens bad.

officialSegments.name: Barnens bad to Gruvbryggan
officialSegments.surface: easy forest road and gravel road
officialSegments.notes: Returns via field/gravel-road context; Lurgatan is a nearby heritage shortcut to Utö Värdshus.

timetableStatusDraft.line21: Waxholmsbolaget v21 PDF found for 2026-04-02 to 2026-06-18 and 2026-08-17 to 2026-12-12; summer 2026 timetable should be checked live or when published.
timetableStatusDraft.nordsyd: SAT states 2026-06-22 to 2026-08-16. Iteration 4 still found static operator exact-time material stale or 2025-labeled, so do not import exact departure times from the research file.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Gruvbryggan ferry trailhead
accessMetadataDraft.description: Main serviced Utö SAT trailhead. SAT says shops, inn, restaurants and all Utö services are available here; line 21 from Årsta brygga is the primary route.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Spränga Brygga alternate trailhead
accessMetadataDraft.description: Alternative ferry access with no services; SAT says hikers can get off here and go directly onto the trail.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Årsta brygga land connection
accessMetadataDraft.description: SL bus 846 connects Västerhaninge station to Årsta brygga and is the main land-side public transport link for Utö line 21.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Nordsyd seasonal Utö connection
accessMetadataDraft.description: SAT says Nordsydlinjen runs June 22-August 16, 2026 and connects Utö with Nåttarö, Ornö and Fjärdlång. Iteration 4 found exact-time files still stale/2025-labeled, so freeze only the 2026 date window and require live operator validation for departures.

accessMetadataDraft.name: Dalarö and Stockholm shoulder-season boat context
accessMetadataDraft.description: Iteration 1 found line 19/20 PDFs showing Stockholm/Dalarö/Ornö/Fjärdlång/Utö shoulder-season possibilities outside the summer gap. Use as planning context only.

privateFallbackDraft.name: BOUT taxi boat fallback
privateFallbackDraft.description: SAT points to BOUT for direct taxi-boat booking when public ferries do not fit.

privateFallbackDraft.name: Utö Värdshus / Sjötaxi context
privateFallbackDraft.description: Utö sources list small-group taxi-boat options, generally ice-free-season and by booking.

accessibilityDraft.summary: SAT says several short Utö route-adjacent options work better for limited mobility: from Gruvbryggan north on gravel road toward Kroka or Barnens bad, east past the inn and mines to Rävstavik, and from Spränga south toward the wetlands. The full SAT loop remains challenging and technical.

campingRulesDraft.summary: Utö nature reserve rules prohibit tents/caravans except on designated places. Utö Camping is the key designated camping service near the route and operates as a paid friluftsmodell campsite.

rulesDraft.name: Utö nature reserve rules
rulesDraft.description: Norra Utö is a nature reserve, protected since 1974 and managed by Skärgårdsstiftelsen. Reserve rules include no damage to geological features/vegetation, no disturbance of wildlife, dogs leashed in the reserve except Persholmen's special rule, no camping except designated places, and no fires except prepared/designated sites.

rulesDraft.name: Fire ban and rock-fire caution
rulesDraft.description: Fire is only allowed at prepared/designated sites and never directly on archipelago rocks. Municipal or county fire bans override designated fireplaces; Skärgårdsstiftelsen lists Haninge/Nynäshamn fire-ban phone information.

rulesDraft.name: Southern Utö shooting-field access warning
rulesDraft.description: Southern Utö shooting-field access restrictions can change and must be checked on signs or with Försvarsmakten before side trips. Iteration 4 found old direct PDF links rotating or dead; use the stable parent/RSS and current field notices rather than cached PDFs. Keep Storsand and shooting-field context out of normal SAT facility import.

rulesDraft.name: Waste and toilet etiquette
rulesDraft.description: SAT asks hikers to bring garbage back to the mainland where possible, use public toilets, avoid private bins/water/toilets, and leave no trace.

utilitiesDraft.name: Utö Gästhamn fresh water
utilitiesDraft.description: Utö Gästhamn says fresh water can be filled at the piers but warns about low pressure in high season. Treat as marina/customer context until public hiker refill terms are verified.

utilitiesDraft.name: Utö Gästhamn waste and environmental station
utilitiesDraft.description: Utö Gästhamn notes a waste and environmental station within walking distance of the harbor; preserve as harbor context, not a route waste point.

waterSourcesDraft.name: Utö pump water candidates
waterSourcesDraft.description: OSM shows several pump/water nodes south/east of the service cluster, but tags include drinking_water=no, unspecified and conditional/osäker om drickbart. Keep out of normal water import.

serviceClustersDraft.name: Gruvbryggan service cluster
serviceClustersDraft.description: The dense service area around Gruvbryggan/Gruvbyn contains the public WC, ferry access, ICA, bakery, harbor cafe/kiosk, restaurants, guest harbor, rentals, lodging and the paid campsite.

serviceClustersDraft.name: Utö Gästhamn marine service cluster
serviceClustersDraft.description: Utö Gästhamn has showers, sauna, toilets, laundry, fresh water, waste/environment station and marina infrastructure. Day users may book showers/sauna, but much of this is paid or boating-oriented.

serviceClustersDraft.name: Gruvbryggan and Gruvbyn commercial services
serviceClustersDraft.description: Seasonal/currentness-sensitive Gruvbryggan and Gruvbyn service context: Utö Värdshus lodging/restaurant, Seglarbaren, Hamnboden kiosk/cafe/harbor reception, Bakgården/Utö Bakgård, paid rentals, pharmacy/post ombud context and guest-harbor paid showers/sauna/laundry/water/waste. Keep out of normal import unless each service is refreshed independently.

facilitiesDraft.name: Gruvbryggan/Hamnboden harbor public toilet
facilitiesDraft.seasonality: reported 24/7 in OSM; verify against current harbor operation during app integration
facilitiesDraft.description: Strong normal toilet candidate at the Gruvbryggan/Hamnboden harbor area. SAT step guide says toilets are in the harbor; OSM marks access=yes, 24/7, flush toilets and drinking_water=yes, but water should stay separate/pending until verified. Iteration 5 avoids the older 'waiting-hall toilet' wording because historic reporting suggests a previous waiting-hall toilet was demolished.

facilitiesDraft.name: Utö Camping
facilitiesDraft.seasonality: operator price page states May-September pricing outside midsummer special pricing; verify current opening before display
facilitiesDraft.description: Designated paid campsite south of the guest harbor and near the SAT route. Operator confirms service cottage with toilets, showers and simple kitchen plus four grill places and its own sandy beach.

facilitiesDraft.name: ICA Nära Utö Livs
facilitiesDraft.seasonality: year-round but with limited and changing hours; verify with ICA before app integration
facilitiesDraft.description: Core resupply candidate in Gruvbyn. Official SAT FAQ lists Utö ICA as the food shop for Utö; ICA's own page shows current opening hours and parcel/Systembolaget-agent services.

facilitiesDraft.publicAccess: yes, subject to reserve and fire-ban rules
facilitiesDraft.description: Route-side wetland rest-area cluster with bird tower, shelter/lean-to and benches. SAT explicitly places a rest area with grill, wind shelter and benches here, and OSM corroborates two lean-to shelter nodes. Import the rest/shelter function normally; keep fire use conditional on live fire-ban and designated-place caveats.

facilitiesDraft.name: Barnens bad toilet
facilitiesDraft.publicAccess: yes, public outdoor toilet at Barnens bad
facilitiesDraft.description: Public toilet at Barnens bad. Iteration 3 split the Barnens bad group into separate beach POI, toilet facility and guarded fire/rest/waste context to avoid duplicate normal app-visible beach/facility records. Iteration 4 removed the brittle Naturkartan deep link from the active source list and kept the toilet through Utö, Länsstyrelsen, OSM and Wikimedia corroboration.

facilitiesDraft.publicAccess: yes, public outdoor toilet evidence from OSM and Wikimedia photo evidence, with brittle Naturkartan/search-index support
facilitiesDraft.description: Skärgårdsmaja/toilet at Rävstavik north. Iterations 4-5 found the Naturkartan deep link brittle and moved it to brittle-source notes, so confidence is medium-high rather than high and the waste-shed detail stays guarded.

facilitiesDraft.name: Hamnboden cafe, kiosk and restaurant
facilitiesDraft.seasonality: likely seasonal; verify current opening hours
facilitiesDraft.description: Harbor cafe/kiosk/restaurant at Gruvbryggan with sushi, hot dogs, toast, sandwiches, coffee, ice cream and kiosk goods. Also functions as camping/harbor payment point. Iteration 2 found current seasonality/closure caveats, so treat as part of the Gruvbryggan commercial service cluster unless current opening hours are verified.

facilitiesDraft.name: Utö Bakgård bakery
facilitiesDraft.seasonality: seasonal/currentness sensitive
facilitiesDraft.description: Bakery/cafe in Gruvbyn, mentioned by SAT/Utö and Explore Archipelago context as part of the service area.
