Iteration 2 should route-proximity check all fire-pit clusters and decide whether Skarsand, Storsand and Vänsviken should be separate or grouped display markers.
Iteration 2 should inspect OSM/Wikimedia/photo evidence for the Storsand toilet and the reported malformed check_date.
Iteration 2 should verify current 2026 summer line 22/Nordsyd publication status again.
Iteration 2 should decide whether rentals should be represented as importable activity metadata, a facility type, or suppressed from app preview because the app may not have a rental facility type.
Later iterations should run duplicate-ID/import-preview checks matching the stricter Rånö validation style.

iterationSummaries.focus: Second Nåttarö pass across potable-water currentness, fire-pit route proximity, toilet import decisions, 2026 transport currentness and app-import/schema QA.
keyFindings: Östermar/Östermarsfladen water stays pending/non-potable: the tap exists, but 2025 OSM/field evidence says a sign warns that water shortage/discoloration makes it unsuitable for drinking.

Storsand water is demoted from normal to pending because no exact public potable tap was verified; SAT lists water, but Länsstyrelsen/Naturkartan confirm toilets only and the Storsand toilet has no drinking-water/handwashing support.
Central water is now stronger: one normal marker is the signed ferry-quay/guest-harbor drinking-water tap, and one normal marker is the camping/service-area water at the toilet/washbasin context.
Ferry quay, Östermarsfladen and Storsand public toilets remain importable; Storsand toilet has a malformed OSM check_date but is supported by 2025 photo/source evidence.
Southern Nåttarö Hals toilet is suppressed for SAT import because it is about 765 m from the route, has only older 2022 OSM evidence and lacks official route/source support.
The four SAT fire-pit contexts remain normal but are now clustered to route-proximate photo/OSM/Grillplatser-backed markers at Östermar, Skarsand, Storsand and Vänsviken.
Hostel/private, duplicate, off-route and tent-area/campsite fire/grill points are not separate normal SAT fire markers; the tent-area grill can remain campsite context.
Transport currentness did not change: current v22/v29/v852 shoulder-autumn PDFs exist, but s22/s29/s40/s852 remain 2025 static summer PDFs; 2026 summer exact times stay live-planner-only.
Line 61 remains freight/goods-line context and must not be imported as passenger access.

QA found no duplicate IDs and no unsupported preview types. Normal POIs are narrowed to previewable swimming/bathing records; cultural/nature POIs stay enrichment records unless the app later supports heritage/attraction types.

iterationSummaries.focus: Third Nåttarö pass across contested water, secondary facilities, POI enrichment/proximity, transport/rules/emergency currentness and strict JSON/import QA.

Östermar water remains pending/non-potable: the mapped tap exists, but current OSM history and field-note wording still point to a 2025 sign saying not to drink due water shortage/discoloration.
Sixtens Bodega is promoted to normal seasonal food with secondary display priority; current operator evidence says it opens at Midsummer and its toilets remain customer-only.
Bryggkiosken and Östermarkiosken stay normal seasonal kiosks; their coordinates were tightened to mapped kiosk/service-building positions.

Nåttarö camping metadata was tightened with operator rules: open Valborg to late September, closed on Midsummer Eve, max seven nights, 18+ without guardian, two dry toilets, dish-room water and tent-area grill context.
Kvarnviken/Ångbåtsbryggan firepit is real but stays secondary because SAT names only Östermarviken, Skarsand, Storsand and Vänsviken as official route cooking places.
Tent-area grill, extra camping/service toilets, limited waste bins and guest-harbor shower/sauna/service-house utilities remain secondary, campsite or guest/customer metadata only.
Normal POIs remain the four app-previewable swimming/snorkel records: Storsand, Skarsand, Kvarnviken snorkel trail and Vänsviken.

Östermarsfladen, Drottninggrottan, Ryssugnar/Bötsudden, Klapperstensfältet, giant-kettle context and Nåttaröhals/Halsudden are valuable enrichment, but not normal app imports under the current preview model.

iterationSummaries.focus: Fourth Nåttarö pass across 2026 service currentness, adversarial water/toilet/fire review, transport/rules currentness, enrichment-layer cleanup and schema/import QA.
keyFindings: Nåttarö Handelsbod remains normal seasonal resupply, but the 2026 operator page is more precise: season started 2026-04-24, May has limited Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun opening, June-August is daily and September is Fri-Sun weather permitting.
Bryggkiosken remains normal seasonal food with 2026 opening listed for Midsummer Eve, 2026-06-19 at 11:00, weather dependent.
Östermarkiosken remains normal seasonal food; iteration 4 removes the preliminary caveat and keeps the operator-listed 2026-06-26 at 11:00 opening.

Nåttarö Krog remains normal seasonal restaurant; operator wording says Valborg opening and weekend service until Midsummer, with exact 2026 times still pending and the 2026-09-06 staff-care closure retained.

Sixtens Bodega remains normal secondary seasonal food, but wording is tightened to current operator evidence: closed until Midsummer 2026 / opens at Midsummer; stale OSM or third-party closure snippets should not override this.

Nåttarö camping remains a normal paid campsite. The Swedish practical-info page is preferred for current terms: Valborg to last weekend in September, closed on Midsummer Eve, max seven nights, 18+ without guardian, two dry toilets, dish-room water, tent-area grill and 60/120 SEK tent fee tiers.

Camping/service-area water is demoted from normal public trail water to campsite/service metadata only. The evidence supports water in a dish-room/toilet/service context, not a standalone public trail drinking-water tap.

The ferry quay/guest-harbor signed drinking-water tap is now the anchor for the only normal west/harbor service-cluster water marker; Östermar remains pending/non-potable and Storsand remains pending without exact potable-tap evidence.

No new toilet or fireplace should be promoted: the three public toilet clusters and four SAT-named fire contexts remain normal; Kvarnviken firepit, tent-area grill, extra camping/service toilets and waste bins remain secondary metadata.

Transport handling was updated: direct s22/s29/s40/s852 PDF URLs exist but still extract as 2025 summer validity, so do not import them as 2026 schedules. Line 22/29 shoulder PDFs and SL 852 current PDF remain current for their validity windows.
SAT FAQ confirms Nordsyd/line 40 2026 operating dates of 2026-06-22 to 2026-08-16, but exact static timetable times remain 2025/live-planner-only until new schedules publish.
Line 61 has a current freight PDF valid 2026-03-23 to 2026-12-12 and passes Nåttarö, but remains freight/goods metadata only, not passenger access.
Reserve rules remain unchanged: dog leash, designated-fire-only, camping limits outside designated campsite, bird closures and fire-ban live-status caveats.
Enrichment records for rentals, Östermarsfladen, Drottninggrottan, Ryssugnar/Bötsudden and Nåttaröhals now carry explicit notTrailFacility/renderPolicy fields to reduce future import leakage risk.
Iteration 4 QA found no duplicate IDs, no missing decision or preview references, and no unsupported appImportPreviewDraft types after the camping-water demotion.

keyFindings: No service demotions are recommended. Handelsbod, Bryggkiosken, Östermarkiosken, Nåttarö Krog, Sixtens Bodega and Nåttarö camping remain normal seasonal imports with the iteration 4 seasonality wording.
Operator pages remain more authoritative than stale OSM opening_hours=closed values, OSM/third-party reservation snippets and generic third-party hour listings.

The west/harbor service-cluster water marker remains normal and high-confidence, anchored on the signed ferry-quay/guest-harbor tap. Additional OSM drinking_water=yes nodes around the west/camping/lodging service area are retained as cluster evidence rather than duplicate normal pins.
Camping/service-area water remains metadata-only because the strongest evidence frames it as dish-room/campsite/service water, not a standalone public trail tap.

Storsand water remains pending because SAT text is not matched by an exact public potable tap in Länsstyrelsen, Naturkartan, OSM or field-photo evidence.

No toilet or fireplace changes are recommended: ferry quay, Östermarsfladen and Storsand toilets remain normal; the four SAT-named fireplace clusters remain normal; extra fire/toilet/waste points remain secondary metadata.

Transport/rules decisions remain stable: current v22/v29/v852b/v61 PDFs have 2026 validity windows, but s22/s29/s40/s852 still extract as 2025 summer schedules. Nordsyd/line 40 should import only the 2026-06-22 to 2026-08-16 operating window, not exact times.
BOUT/Nåttarö taxi boat remains private/on-demand fallback metadata only; fire-ban status remains volatile/live-check only.
Normal POIs remain the four preview-compatible swimming/snorkel records: Storsand, Skarsand, Kvarnviken snorkel trail and Vänsviken.
Östermarsfladen, Drottninggrottan, Ryssugnar/Bötsudden, Nåttaröhals/Halsudden and Klapperstensfältet/giant-kettle context remain enrichment-only under the current supported preview types.

Final QA found no duplicate IDs, no missing decision or preview references, no pending/suppressed leakage, no unsupported preview types and a clean 14 normal facilities + 4 normal POIs = 18 preview records alignment.

Route-proximity documentation was added for every appImportPreviewDraft record, including explicit notes for the campsite and Östermarviken fireplace records that sit just outside the raw H25 bbox but are valid buffered-corridor trail/service records.

Source policy now explicitly preserves the official working SAT typo URL questions-and-aswers and functional query strings, and it warns not to merge away working nattaro.se operator URL variants solely by path spelling.

Current SAT facts use the shorter H25 route, while older PDF/Naturkartan/Explore sources still describe a longer 13.6-13.7 km variant.

safetyWarningsDraft.message: The eastern singletrack and northern cape are technically challenging; wet rocks and cliffside sections can be slippery.
Ferry docking can change between North, East and West harbor depending on weather/ice; check current planner and local quay information.
Use only designated fire places and never light fires on rocks; fire bans override all static trail information.
Decommissioned military installations are visible around Öja; Ersta/Batteri Landsort interior visits require guided tour booking and should not be described as freely accessible.

lodgingMetadataDraft.summary: Landsort has bookable hostel, Lotstornet hotel/B&B and cottage rental. These are important visitor context but guest utilities should not become public trail facilities.

iterationSummaries.focus: Initial Landsort research across route facts/geometry, public facilities, transport/rules/safety, POI enrichment and schema/import-shape planning.
keyFindings: Current SAT Landsort facts are 10.7 km, moderate, 3:45 and 55 m elevation gain; use these rather than older 13.6-13.7 km sources.

Use the current SAT-hosted H25 GPX / Outdooractive 331283726 geometry. The GPX has 494 points, starts/ends near Österhamn, computes to about 10.272 km and has bounds 58.737661-58.773549 / 17.858153-17.868133.
